sections.title: New Features
items: Added Quit All and Eject All to Thunderstorm: type "quit all" or "eject all" to close every running app or eject every removable disk at once.
Added Media Player Text and Widget Text color settings under Theming to recolor the now-playing media text and lock-screen widget text for any wallpaper.
Added a Notes option to grow the canvas through three sizes as a note gets longer.
Added a Notes option to hide the formatting toolbar for a minimal editor, with the keyboard shortcuts still working.
Added markdown keyboard shortcuts to the Notes editor for bold, italic, underline, highlight, headings, and lists.
Added an opt-in Solid Settings Background toggle under Theming that swaps the Settings window glass for an opaque backing so text stays legible on dark wallpapers.
Added a Keyboard Brightness Keys toggle under HUD Replacement for BetterDisplay/Karabiner users who remap brightness to keyboard keys; it is off by default so clipboard tools keep working.
Redesigned the Pomodoro and High Alert timer widgets around an iOS-style tape scrubber: drag or scroll the minute ruler to dial in any duration, with haptic ticks as it passes each minute.
Added an ∞ stop at the start of High Alert's scrubber that starts an indefinite stay-awake session, and the picked duration is now remembered across restarts.
Added support for recording the fn key in shortcuts, alone or combined with other keys.
Added Dynamic Glass, a new notch and island look where the surface fades from black into real Liquid Glass, now the default on macOS 26 and newer.
Added a Notched Display picker under Theming to switch the built-in notch between Dynamic Glass and classic Black.
Added Dynamic Glass as a third surface style for notchless displays, next to Black and Liquid Glass.

Added Multi Live Activities: start a timer or recording while music plays and it takes over the notch while the media art flows into its own floating pill on the right, just like iPhone's split Dynamic Island.
Added tap-to-expand on the live-activity pill, opening the shelf straight into that activity.
Added a Multi Live Activities toggle under Settings, HUDs, Media.
Extended Multi Live Activities to every activity pairing: coding assistant, voice transcribe, TermiNotch, and the meeting call chip now split the island with media, timers, and each other.
Added a Live Audio Visualizer: the music bars now move to the audio that is actually playing, like the iPhone's Dynamic Island, with a toggle under Settings, HUDs, Media.
Added a Permissions overview under Settings, General that lists every permission with live status and one-click grant.
Redesigned the Clipboard Manager as a native macOS 26 window with a sidebar, content sheet, and streamlined action bar.
Added clipboard sidebar filters for favorites, pinned, types, and tags, each with live item counts.
Redesigned the clipboard tag editor with inline renaming, color swatches, drag reordering, and a quick New Tag row.
Made Thunderstorm available to everyone: the unlock code is gone and the droplet works right after installing.
Redesigned Thunderstorm as a Spotlight-style bar that opens empty and centered on screen, with results appearing as you type.
Gave Thunderstorm the Dynamic Glass look on macOS 26 and newer, fading from black into real Liquid Glass like the shelf.
Added the Notes droplet: a quick iOS-style notepad widget for the shelf that works standalone or split with another widget.
Notes auto-save as you type with live markdown and a formatting row for bold, headings, and lists.
Added pin-to-top, drag reordering, quick copy, and hover delete to the Notes widget's list.
Added per-note open shortcuts: right-click a note to record a global shortcut that opens it from anywhere.
Added Left and Right Two Thirds snap options to Window Snap, with default shortcuts Ctrl+Opt+S and Ctrl+Opt+H.
Pinned screenshots now hide their frame, title, and opacity slider when the cursor leaves, leaving just the image floating until you hover again.
Added ==highlight== marking support to the note editors, with a highlighter button in the formatting row.
Added Duplicate and Rename to the right-click menu when browsing inside a folder in Thunderstorm.
Added Open in Finder to Thunderstorm's folder-browsing right-click menu.
Added drag-and-drop tagging in the Clipboard window: drop one or more entries onto a sidebar tag to assign it.
Clipboard entries can also be dropped onto Favorites or Pinned in the sidebar to mark them.
Added a color picker to the notes highlighter: hover the button and pick from six marker colors.
Added Favorites: pin up to two widgets beside the floating navigation bar to keep them one tap away under the shelf.
Added a Widget Settings panel under Shelf, Widgets that configures every widget in one place, even the ones not currently on the shelf.
Added system actions to Thunderstorm: eject disks, uninstall or quit apps, and lock, sleep, restart, log out, or shut down your Mac from the search panel.
Renamed the Coding Companion droplet to Claude Code/Codex, focused entirely on Claude Code and Codex, with new icons, screenshots, and an animated Claude mark.

Added an Apple Music Automix indicator: during a natural track transition the waveform briefly becomes Apple's interlocked-rings mark, with the left ring in the outgoing track's color and the right ring in the incoming one.

Redesigned the Droppy Cloud storage view to match iOS's iCloud storage screen, with a multi-color usage meter that fills in section by section and tappable file-type sections that expand into the files inside.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed macOS Three Finger Drag shakes registering inconsistently and the drag preview lingering after you lift your fingers.
Fixed the now-playing media player crushing its album art and visualizer against the notch edges on external displays using the simulated notch.
Fixed the shelf quick actions opening while dragging a file below the notch, which could block drops onto a browser's bookmark bar; they now appear only when the cursor is on the notch.
Fixed the AirPods features never triggering the Bluetooth permission prompt on first use.
Fixed clicks in the transparent area beside the expanded shelf being blocked instead of passing through to the app underneath, most noticeable with Auto Collapse off.
Fixed the notch mini-player's album art and EQ icons clipping behind the notch on taller or scaled-resolution displays when the track title is short.
Fixed the scrolling-capture auto-scroll anchoring the cursor to a vertically mirrored position, which could misdirect the scroll for off-center or windowed captures.
Fixed the Mail Quick Action's Default option doing nothing when your default mail app isn't Apple Mail; it now opens your actual default mail client with the file attached.
Dropping files on the Mail Quick Action now opens a compose window in default mail apps that can't take attachments, instead of silently doing nothing.
Fixed horizontal scrolling through the shelf's droplet strips not working with a physical mouse's horizontal scroll wheel or tilt; those rows now scroll sideways correctly.
Fixed the Clipboard window's bottom action bar getting cut off on short external displays; the window now clamps to fit the display and stays fully on screen.
Fixed the media player lingering in the notch after you close the browser tab or window that was playing; the browser bridge now clears the session the moment the page is torn down.
Fixed Droppy's media-key handling interfering with PopClip, Enpass, and other clipboard and text tools (a blip sound and broken copy/paste); Droppy no longer watches keyboard events by default.
Fixed Meeting Controls falsely detecting a Microsoft Teams meeting (popping the HUD and grabbing your mic/music) when you were only in Teams chat or Teams was just using the microphone.
Fixed Element Capture taking a duplicate screenshot when you clicked again (or clicked the preview) while the first capture was still finishing.
Fixed a visual clipping glitch from trackpad swipes over the notch while the onboarding (or update/transcription) card is shown.
Fixed the notch rendering with square corners under the Liquid Glass theme on macOS Sequoia; it now follows the curved silhouette.
Improved Notify Me notification reliability on macOS Tahoe (it now reconnects when macOS rebuilds its notification database) and stopped it from dropping delayed iPhone-mirrored notifications.
Fixed the notch disappearing after waking your Mac from a lid-close sleep; it now returns on its own without needing to open Settings.
Fixed a crash in Terminotch when a command produced a heavy, continuous stream of output (for example downloading a model with ollama).
Fixed the Clipboard recording passwords copied from browser password-manager extensions; clips an app marks as a password or sensitive are now always skipped, regardless of the source app.
Fixed the Dynamic Island not collapsing (and the audio visualizer continuing to animate) when you pause playback from the Island itself rather than in the source app.
Fixed the physical mouse wheel not scrolling when Smooth Scrolling was enabled without Liquid Mode on macOS Tahoe; trackpad scrolling was unaffected.
Fixed Beta Updates keeping you on an older build when a newer public release was available; Droppy now offers whichever of the beta and public builds is newest.
Fixed shake-to-summon basket and shelf drag targets when using macOS Three Finger Drag.
Fixed the Basket Switcher shortcut firing on its own when set to a lone modifier key (e.g. Option); it now requires a full key combination.
Fixed a click outside the shelf occasionally closing a shelf you had just reopened within a fraction of a second.
Fixed the temporarily hidden notch still swallowing clicks and hovers in the area it normally occupies.
Fixed the file tray chip showing how many files you just added instead of the total number of files in the tray.
Fixed the file tray chip rendering on top of other compact HUDs like the terminal, recording, meeting, and AirPods chips.
Fixed unzipping a large archive freezing the entire interface until extraction finished; extraction also no longer gets killed after 30 seconds.
Fixed a failed unzip leaving a half-extracted folder next to the archive.
Fixed compressing two same-named files (or the same file twice) overwriting the earlier compressed result that was still on the shelf.
Fixed Smart Export silently dropping files when its destination folder had been deleted; it now recreates the folder or falls back to Downloads.
Fixed document conversion hanging forever on a corrupt file when LibreOffice stalls; it now fails cleanly after two minutes.
Fixed moving files to another drive aborting when a same-named file already existed in the destination.
Fixed renaming an item to an empty name creating an invisible hidden file; slashes and colons in names are now replaced like Finder does.
Fixed a resource leak in watched-folder tracking that could eventually stop folder monitoring until an app restart.
Fixed duplicate-name suffixes producing names with a trailing dot for files without an extension.
Fixed the basket window snapping to its new size while its contents animated when files were added or removed.
Fixed invisible hidden basket windows swallowing clicks and drops aimed at the Basket Switcher cards.
Fixed shake-to-summon occasionally doing nothing when the shake landed while a basket was still animating closed.
Fixed a basket re-opened during its auto-hide fade being hidden again a moment later.
Fixed a back-swipe over an extension page's screenshot gallery navigating back instead of scrolling the gallery.
Fixed previewing a HUD color twice in quick succession permanently turning on HUD replacement for users who had it off.
Fixed opening Settings silently re-enabling the Volume HUD replacement when only the Keyboard Brightness HUD was enabled.
Fixed swiping between the shelf's Droppy, Tray, and Widgets pages sometimes needing two or three attempts; quick flicks now register on the first try.

Fixed the tab swipe only working near the top of the shelf when the droplet or file strip filled the surface; swiping now also switches pages when the strip can't scroll any further in that direction.
Fixed Notify Me showing banners during a Focus or Do Not Disturb session; they now stay silent like native banners while still landing in history.
Fixed notifications arriving while the shelf was open being silently swallowed; they now queue and appear once the shelf closes.
Fixed a cleared notification being able to briefly reappear right after Clear All or a quick double dismiss.
Fixed a rare burst of replayed notifications when macOS rotated its notification database at a busy moment.
Fixed swiping a notification away occasionally dismissing the next queued notification before it was ever seen.
Fixed the Pomodoro and High Alert pills (and other small HUDs) peeking out while the shelf was still closing; they now emerge from the notch only after it has fully settled.
Extended the settled close reveal to every remaining small HUD: voice transcribe, meeting controls, terminal, notifications, AirPods, Droppy Cloud, network cards, and the AI coding chip.
Fixed clicking the notch while the voice transcribe pill was visible opening a plain shelf instead of the transcribe surface.
Added the same tap-through for the TermiNotch pill: clicking it now opens the terminal surface.
Fixed the meeting call HUD's speaker bars never moving; macOS was silently denying Droppy's system audio access because the permission prompt was missing.
Fixed the expanded media player (and lock-screen media panel) suddenly opening at the full shelf size when a legacy Regular size preference was stored; both now always use the compact layout.
Fixed the 3-day trial staying unlocked past its expiry until the next relaunch; it now ends on time while Droppy keeps running.
Fixed the lock screen media panel and status widgets staying invisible for the rest of the lock session when re-shown during their hide animation.
Fixed the unlock animation breaking (lock chip popping out without its collapse morph) when the screensaver ended while the Mac was still locked.
Fixed the lock screen media panel mounting on top of the screensaver when media changed right as the screensaver started.
Fixed waking the display while locked snapping the expanded lock screen album art back to compact instead of restoring it.
Fixed a rare crash risk when the lock screen side slider tore down while resizing.
Fixed muted autoplaying videos (news sites, social feeds) stealing the media player from Spotify or Apple Music while your music kept playing.
Fixed the previous app's album cover staying stuck next to the new track when playback switched between Spotify and Apple Music.
Fixed motion album art not loading for the first Apple Music track after switching from another source.
Fixed pausing from the notch sometimes flickering back to the playing state before the app confirmed the pause.
Fixed the media progress bar jumping backward when a song's info refreshed mid-track.
Fixed the Spotify like heart showing the previous song's liked state right after a track change.
Fixed pause clicks on a muted or background browser video starting playback in a paused music app instead.
Fixed the volume HUD no longer appearing for volume changes made outside Droppy after switching audio output, such as connecting AirPods.
Fixed brightness keys and the brightness HUD dying permanently after docking, undocking, or clamshell sessions until Droppy was relaunched.
Fixed HUDs queued behind a long-lived HUD (like the lock screen) popping up out of context minutes later.
Fixed an interrupted HUD handoff occasionally replacing a newer HUD with the older one it had just dismissed.
Fixed the No Internet card being dismissed early by a leftover VPN HUD timer.
Fixed a queued No Internet card silently blocking battery, caps lock, and other HUDs until relaunch when the connection recovered before it was shown.
Fixed the floating basket popping up on its own when holding the mouse button after an earlier file drag, such as while moving a Finder window.
Fixed unplugging a display while the shelf was open on it leaving Droppy swallowing Space, Cmd+A, and Delete in other windows and routing new drops to the missing display.
Fixed files dropped into a fresh basket from Apple Mail getting lost when basket auto-hide closed the basket during the export.
Fixed clearing the last shelf item deleting temp files that a floating basket or an in-progress copy still needed.
Fixed a slow buildup of duplicate internal state watchers across sleep/wake cycles that gradually made the notch less responsive.
Fixed Paste All pasting the last selected clip multiple times instead of each selected clip.
Fixed converting portrait iPhone photos producing sideways images; EXIF orientation is now preserved.
Fixed Clear History on Quit occasionally being undone by an in-flight save re-creating the history file.
Fixed exporting multiple selected emails from Apple Mail producing a single broken file instead of one per message.
Fixed a file deleted from a watched folder and re-downloaded with the same name never reappearing on the shelf.
Fixed converting the same LibreOffice document twice corrupting the first conversion still on the shelf.
Fixed PDF export closing a document you already had open in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or Pages and discarding unsaved changes.
Fixed closing the Compress to Target Size dialog with its close button leaving the item stuck on a compressing spinner forever.
Fixed clipboard images dragged out as PNG files containing raw TIFF data that some apps and websites rejected.
Fixed a failed target-size video compression leaving a corrupt half-written video in your folder.
Fixed the Reminders droplet's completed-task auto-cleanup never running.
Fixed removing the Reminders droplet leaving its sync timers, due-soon alerts, and quick-open shortcut running.
Fixed a Reminders sync racing a just-created task deleting it and re-adding it with its priority reset.
Fixed turning Mechey off and back on leaving it silent until the next app restart.
Fixed Mechey mouse-click sounds dying permanently after sleep or login until toggled.
Fixed Mechey soundpack installs freezing the interface and reporting failed extractions as installed.
Fixed clicking an unresponsive app freezing Droppy for several seconds with WindowSnap pointer mode enabled.
Fixed renaming a note only by letter case (test to Test) creating a duplicate instead of renaming.
Fixed pressing Esc to finish a scrolling capture throwing away everything captured instead of saving it.
Fixed the screenshot editor's undo removing the wrong annotation after moving or resizing one; moves and edits are now undoable steps.
Fixed the screenshot editor's Save to File dialog opening behind the editor window.
Fixed fast scrolling during a scrolling capture producing torn or duplicated bands in the stitched image.
Fixed the FFmpeg and Ghostscript installers hanging forever partway through the download.
Fixed cancelling a voice transcription or model download leaving it running in the background and breaking the next recording.
Fixed quickly closing and reopening the camera wedging the preview black until relaunch.
Fixed transcribing mp3 and m4a files freezing the interface during conversion.
Fixed lyrics with an embedded timing offset drifting in the wrong direction.
Improved OCR accuracy on scanned PDFs by reading pages at full resolution instead of 72 DPI.
Fixed reopening the onboarding tour permanently switching the Shelf on for users who had it disabled.
Fixed in-app links to a specific Settings page doing nothing when Settings was already open.
Fixed several Settings search results opening the wrong page, and removed search entries for settings that no longer exist.
Fixed opening Settings with the lid open silently erasing the Hide in Mission Control preference for clamshell users.
Fixed importing settings from another Mac transplanting its license and trial identity onto this one.
Fixed hiding the Droppy Cloud tab from inside it leaving the sidebar with no selected page.
Fixed the License tab showing a blank page in builds without license checks; it is now hidden.
Fixed the Clipboard window sometimes opening behind other apps' windows.
Fixed clipboard clicks being ignored or highlighting the wrong entry after a lock or unlock left phantom modifier keys pressed.
Fixed the Clipboard window's selection highlight sometimes sticking to the previous entry while the preview already showed the new one.
Fixed Cmd+A and Delete inside shelf note editors being captured by the shelf's select-all and remove shortcuts.
Fixed formatting buttons in note editors dropping keyboard focus; typing now continues right after tapping Bold or a heading.
Fixed the Thunderstorm and Clipboard shortcuts doing nothing when pressed during the window's closing animation; the reopen is now queued.
Fixed Apple Calendar event alerts re-appearing in Notify Me over and over until the event was completed or Droppy was restarted.
Fixed Cmd+A, Cmd+C/V/X, and undo shortcuts not working inside the markdown note editors.
Fixed the Notify Me widget opening at its full list height for a single notification; it now uses a compact card instead of a huge mostly-empty surface.
Fixed file conversions and compressions (video, PDF, Office, ZIP, HTML) that could hang a basket indefinitely when the underlying tool stalled, leaving it stuck with a spinner.
Fixed basket and clipboard thumbnails sometimes rendering blurry when the same item was shown at different sizes.
Fixed pinned Power Folders in one basket being dropped when toggling a pin in another basket.
Fixed creating a ZIP or folder from a right-clicked, unselected basket item leaving that item selected afterwards.
Fixed a folder preview occasionally popping up detached after its item was removed from the shelf or basket.
Fixed the Terminal droplet continuing to capture keystrokes after being disabled while its surface stayed open.
Fixed Cmd+C in the screenshot editor not working on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts.
Fixed the most recent clipboard entry occasionally not being saved when turning off clipboard history.
Fixed removing the Voice Transcribe droplet mid-download leaving a live-model download running in the background.
Fixed the notch briefly misreading Google Meet screen-sharing state for a few seconds after switching browsers.
Stopped files dropped onto the basket switcher from leaving leftover copies behind.
Stopped Quick Look of clipboard images from piling up temporary files over a session.
Stopped dropped web links from silently fetching private or local network addresses.
Fixed a running Terminal command continuing in the background after the Terminal droplet was removed; in-flight commands are now stopped on teardown.
Fixed the Widget Settings overview row only responding to taps on its far right; the whole row now expands.
Fixed the active-widget count not updating immediately after a droplet was activated.
Fixed clicking a clipboard entry sometimes selecting the wrong row or not registering after the list reordered, such as right after pinning an item.
Fixed the High Alert and Pomodoro timer ruler ignoring an external mouse; you can now click a minute to set it or drag the ruler with the cursor.
Fixed clipboard selection highlights sometimes sticking on the wrong rows in the list, pinned, and favorites sections while selecting or reordering entries.
Fixed the now-playing display lagging behind, with pause, track changes, and source switches taking seconds to register, caused by the media helper relaunching in a loop at startup.
Fixed the album art sometimes keeping the previous track's cover after skipping to the next song.
Fixed two web players open in the same browser mixing their metadata, such as one site's title appearing with another site's artist and cover.
Fixed Liquid Mouse's Smooth Scrolling completely blocking the mouse wheel on the latest macOS by delivering its smoothed scrolling the same way trackpad scrolling already reaches apps.
Added a Liquid Mouse safety net that reverts to normal wheel scrolling whenever its smoothing engine can't deliver, so turning on Smooth Scrolling can never leave the wheel unable to scroll.
Fixed clicking the collapsed update notification in the notch doing nothing; it now opens the update panel.
Fixed the notch occasionally keeping a phantom open shelf or hover glow after returning from full screen or Mission Control.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Redesigned the color options under Theming as scrubbable iOS-style color tapes in a grid, with haptic ticks as you pass each color and a custom hex swatch at the end.
Improved opening the Notes and TermiNotch widgets standalone so the cursor lands in the text field immediately, without an extra click.
Made the collapsed notch grow down out of the top edge when it reappears on external and notchless displays, instead of fading in flat.
Improved drop-and-expand smoothness by deferring thumbnail, icon, and context-menu work until after the shelf's open animation settles.
Condensed onboarding from thirteen pages to five focused ones; deferred permissions are now requested when their feature first needs them.
Improved the smoothness of opening the expanded shelf by removing per-frame window resizing during the open animation.
Further reduced CPU usage during Microsoft Teams calls by ending the meeting-controls accessibility scan as soon as it has the call's mute, camera, and leave state.
Reduced CPU usage from Meeting Controls detection during rapid app-focus changes, such as while screen sharing in Microsoft Teams.
Slimmed the media player's hover control chips to a tighter, better-proportioned size.
Significantly lowered idle CPU usage by skipping the notch's hover edge-detection work when nothing is hovered, expanded, or near the top of the screen.

Reduced background CPU and battery drain by pausing or relaxing many timers when their feature isn't on screen, including the browser-media, basket auto-hide, clipboard, VPN, update-check, shelf-cleanup, Quickshare, and AI coding session watchers.
Stopped the meeting-call HUD width timer, low-battery pulse, and AirPods breathing animations from continuing to run after they leave the screen.
Made shelf closing noticeably smoother by holding the window's behind-the-scenes resize until the close animation has fully settled.
Made shelf opening and closing smoother in both single and split widget mode by lightening the blur the expanded surface animates through.
Made the floating basket animate back in when it reappears (auto-hide reveals and re-opens), matching its animated hide instead of snapping into place.
Smoothed merging multiple baskets into one — spawned baskets now fade out instead of vanishing instantly.
Unified the hover and drop-target animations on the basket quick-actions bar and clipboard thumbnails with the rest of the app's motion.
Made the shelf's wing buttons (Droppy/Tray switcher and Widgets pill) ride the same drop-down reveal as the shelf surface instead of fading in place.
Stopped the floating nav bar from playing a second pop-out animation on top of the shelf's own open reveal.
Smoothed shelf closing on external displays with the idle notch hidden — the fade-out now waits for the close animation to settle.
Made every element in the shelf (shadow, outline, media artwork, badges, hover controls) move on the same spring as the shelf itself during open and close.
Fixed the notification HUD fading in twice when it appears in the notch.
Fixed a song change mid open/close briefly fighting the shelf animation with its own track-title reveal.
Aligned the Caffeine and Pomodoro start/stop animations with the rest of the in-shelf motion so they no longer feel like a second shelf opening.
Made shelf open/close noticeably smoother on Dynamic Island displays by rendering the shadow on the GPU instead of re-blurring it every frame.
Made swiping the shelf closed on Dynamic Island displays fade the shadow with your gesture, matching notched MacBooks.
Removed dozens of hidden per-frame scheduling hops during the shelf open animation.
Made the shelf close slightly faster than it opens, so dismissing feels decisive instead of lingering.
Stopped a play/pause change landing mid open/close from animating against the shelf motion.
Fixed the heavy stutter when opening or closing the shelf with two widgets side by side.
Made the shelf shadow fade in and out on exactly the same clock as the shelf itself instead of finishing early.
Made the shelf reveal noticeably smoother by retiring the per-frame blur pass it animated through.
Paused the audio visualizer bars during shelf open and close so the animation keeps its full frame budget.
Made every shelf and media player animation noticeably smoother by re-enabling compiler optimization across their entire rendering code.
Made switching between widgets inside the open shelf smoother by removing the per-frame blur it animated through.
Made the expanded shelf the same width with the regular wing buttons as with the floating nav bar, instead of growing wider in wing-button mode.
Made creating a ZIP from large shelf items near-instant by linking files into the archive instead of copying them first.
Stopped the first right-click conversion menu from pausing while Droppy checks for WebP tools; the check now runs in the background at launch.
Moved Smart Export auto-saves and Save to Downloads copies off the main thread so large files no longer cause interface hitches.
Creating a folder from the notch shelf now auto-starts renaming it, matching the basket.
Unified duplicate-name handling to Finder-style " 2" suffixes across conversions, compressions, exports, and moves.
Unified the basket window's close, hide, and auto-hide animations into one consistent motion.
Made toggling basket settings reveal their extra options with a smooth animation instead of popping in.
Smoothed the expanded basket during hover and selection by moving file-size lookups off the render path.
Unified the hover animation across all Basket Switcher cards.
Made basket item thumbnails fade in quietly instead of bouncing in on the hover spring.
Unified rename, folder preview, due-date, and editor option popovers on the native macOS popover look.
Made the Clipboard window snappier with large histories by grouping pinned, favorite, and recent items once per change instead of on every redraw.
Made reopening the Clipboard window shortly after closing it instant by keeping its content warm instead of rebuilding from scratch.
Moved clipboard image thumbnail decoding off the interface thread so scrolling the history stays smooth.
Redesigned extension page screenshots as an App Store-style gallery that snaps to each screenshot as you swipe.
Restyled the to-do Edit Task popovers as native macOS popover forms with a standard text field and buttons, matching the rename popover.
Holding the keyboard backlight shortcut now keeps stepping the brightness, matching the volume and display brightness keys.
Redesigned Notify Me! notifications in the iPhone style with a sender avatar, badged app icon, and two-line message preview.
Clarified the Notify Me Hide Native Banners tip: set the alert style to None and keep Allow Notifications on so capture keeps working.
Stopped the lock screen weather and AQI widgets from polling your location and weather for the entire app session after unlocking.
Stopped the droplet preview cards in Settings from animating forever after a hover, quietly burning CPU while Settings was open.
Fixed quickly reopening the shelf during the update card's teardown window making the fresh shelf vanish in a single frame.
Fixed rapid shelf tab switches letting the shelf auto-collapse under you mid-switch.
Fixed the ZIP icon growing noticeably more than other icons on hover.
Fixed the AirPods pill rendering frozen (no breathing, instant battery ring) because its connect animation played before the pill was on screen.
Fixed hovering a scrolling filename right after un-hovering making the text teleport mid-glide.
Substantially reduced the lyrics widget's GPU load by capping its drifting blurred backdrop at 30fps instead of full display refresh rate.
Aligned the timer scrubber settle, settings checkmark, shelf glass crossfade, and outline fade with the app's central motion system for consistent feel across displays.
Fixed a second copied-text toast being dismissed almost instantly when it arrived during the previous toast's fade-out.
Fixed cancelling a basket reorder drag leaving the dragged card stuck semi-transparent until the next drop.
Fixed creating a folder or ZIP in the basket silently breaking basket auto-hide for the rest of the session.
Fixed rapid page swipes in the zoomed clipboard preview making the content teleport mid-slide.
Made opening the basket reorder panel fade the basket out smoothly instead of snapping it away.
Unified the clipboard tag editor's hover and selection motion with the rest of the app.
Replaced the clipboard background removal overlay with a quiet progress ring on the row.
Restyled the clipboard search field to match the native macOS capsule look.
Made the onboarding welcome page the same height as the other pages so the Continue button never moves while clicking through.
Evened out the expanded media player's vertical spacing; the gap below the transport controls now matches the gap above the artwork.
Made Thunderstorm's first summon instant by warming the panel and search index in the background.
Wrapped Notify Me! banners in an iOS-style translucent message card that nests concentrically inside the notch and island corners.
Restyled Thunderstorm's rename prompt as a native macOS popover anchored to the file row.
Pinned screenshot windows can now be dragged anywhere on screen instead of being clamped inside the visible area.
Made the High Alert and Pomodoro timer rulers highlight only the duration up to your selection, dimming the unselected minutes.

Reduced recurring main-thread work that could cause brief stutters, including brightness polling, the Settings permissions overview, the app-exclusion picker, and now-playing helper restarts after waking.
Fixed background CPU slowly accumulating after repeated display, wake, or unlock transitions.
Removed a per-frame allocation on the real-time audio thread that could glitch the spectrum visualizer.
Made the screenshot editor smoother when dragging while a magnifier is on the canvas.
Smoothed remaining edge cases in rapid track skips and the secondary activity pill so they no longer snap or stick.
Made the screenshot editor much smoother when a blur region is present by caching the pixelated patch instead of recomputing it on every frame.
Capped the screenshot editor's undo history so long annotation sessions no longer grow memory without bound.
Made expanding a full basket and scrolling its grid or list view much smoother with many files by removing a per-frame re-render that ran during the animation.
Gave Droppy Cloud a new icon.
Made Thunderstorm the first featured droplet in the store.
Extended Thunderstorm's Duplicate, Rename, and Open in Finder actions to any file result, not just while browsing inside a folder.
Removed the clipboard from Thunderstorm now that the dedicated Clipboard window handles it, rewrote its description, and renamed its shortcut setting to "Shortcut".
Replaced the droplet store's category filter chips with real Liquid Glass buttons.
Vertically centered the Thunderstorm Shortcut row label, the Permissions overview icons, and the Widget Settings rows so controls line up.
Moved the Multi Live Activities setting into Shelf, Layout with On and Off preview cards.
Rebuilt the Compress to Target Size dialog as a native popover anchored to the file (like the rename popover) with native controls.
Restyled the droplet Turn On and Turn Off buttons as subtle Liquid Glass instead of bold red and green pills.
Reworked the shelf lyrics to match the lock-screen look, with a tighter, narrower panel and no colored glow behind the text.
Gave the lyrics pop-out window a Dynamic Glass surface instead of the tinted album-art card.
Made long media titles in the shelf player fade out at the edge like the artist name instead of cutting off with an ellipsis.
Browser media now uses the system-provided cover art directly instead of discarding it or swapping in a fetched thumbnail.
The audio visualizer now only reacts to real captured audio and rests flat when none is captured, instead of animating on its own.
The Automix indicator also appears in the collapsed notch, and the waveform crossfades smoothly into it and back.
Muted the expanded media player's timeline slider slightly so it reads softer than pure white.
Gave the update window the Dynamic Glass look, fading from black into real Liquid Glass like the shelf.
Removed the outer card border around the Droppy Cloud usage summary and restyled its menu bar, sidebar, and upload-confirmation options as a single segmented control.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added an opt-in Solid Settings Background toggle under Theming that swaps the Settings window glass for an opaque backing so text stays legible on dark wallpapers.
Added a Keyboard Brightness Keys toggle under HUD Replacement for BetterDisplay/Karabiner users who remap brightness to keyboard keys; it is off by default so clipboard tools keep working.
Redesigned the Pomodoro and High Alert timer widgets around an iOS-style tape scrubber: drag or scroll the minute ruler to dial in any duration, with haptic ticks as it passes each minute.
Added an ∞ stop at the start of High Alert's scrubber that starts an indefinite stay-awake session, and the picked duration is now remembered across restarts.
Added support for recording the fn key in shortcuts, alone or combined with other keys.
Added Dynamic Glass, a new notch and island look where the surface fades from black into real Liquid Glass, now the default on macOS 26 and newer.
Added a Notched Display picker under Theming to switch the built-in notch between Dynamic Glass and classic Black.
Added Dynamic Glass as a third surface style for notchless displays, next to Black and Liquid Glass.

Added Multi Live Activities: start a timer or recording while music plays and it takes over the notch while the media art flows into its own floating pill on the right, just like iPhone's split Dynamic Island.
Added tap-to-expand on the live-activity pill, opening the shelf straight into that activity.
Added a Multi Live Activities toggle under Settings, HUDs, Media.
Extended Multi Live Activities to every activity pairing: coding assistant, voice transcribe, TermiNotch, and the meeting call chip now split the island with media, timers, and each other.
Added a Live Audio Visualizer: the music bars now move to the audio that is actually playing, like the iPhone's Dynamic Island, with a toggle under Settings, HUDs, Media.
Added a Permissions overview under Settings, General that lists every permission with live status and one-click grant.
Redesigned the Clipboard Manager as a native macOS 26 window with a sidebar, content sheet, and streamlined action bar.
Added clipboard sidebar filters for favorites, pinned, types, and tags, each with live item counts.
Redesigned the clipboard tag editor with inline renaming, color swatches, drag reordering, and a quick New Tag row.
Made Thunderstorm available to everyone: the unlock code is gone and the droplet works right after installing.
Redesigned Thunderstorm as a Spotlight-style bar that opens empty and centered on screen, with results appearing as you type.
Gave Thunderstorm the Dynamic Glass look on macOS 26 and newer, fading from black into real Liquid Glass like the shelf.
Added the Notes droplet: a quick iOS-style notepad widget for the shelf that works standalone or split with another widget.
Notes auto-save as you type with live markdown and a formatting row for bold, headings, and lists.
Added pin-to-top, drag reordering, quick copy, and hover delete to the Notes widget's list.
Added per-note open shortcuts: right-click a note to record a global shortcut that opens it from anywhere.
Added Left and Right Two Thirds snap options to Window Snap, with default shortcuts Ctrl+Opt+S and Ctrl+Opt+H.
Pinned screenshots now hide their frame, title, and opacity slider when the cursor leaves, leaving just the image floating until you hover again.
Added ==highlight== marking support to the note editors, with a highlighter button in the formatting row.
Added Duplicate and Rename to the right-click menu when browsing inside a folder in Thunderstorm.
Added Open in Finder to Thunderstorm's folder-browsing right-click menu.
Added drag-and-drop tagging in the Clipboard window: drop one or more entries onto a sidebar tag to assign it.
Clipboard entries can also be dropped onto Favorites or Pinned in the sidebar to mark them.
Added a color picker to the notes highlighter: hover the button and pick from six marker colors.
Added Favorites: pin up to two widgets beside the floating navigation bar to keep them one tap away under the shelf.
Added a Widget Settings panel under Shelf, Widgets that configures every widget in one place, even the ones not currently on the shelf.
Added system actions to Thunderstorm: eject disks, uninstall or quit apps, and lock, sleep, restart, log out, or shut down your Mac from the search panel.
Renamed the Coding Companion droplet to Claude Code/Codex, focused entirely on Claude Code and Codex, with new icons, screenshots, and an animated Claude mark.

Added an Apple Music Automix indicator: during a natural track transition the waveform briefly becomes Apple's interlocked-rings mark, with the left ring in the outgoing track's color and the right ring in the incoming one.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed the shelf quick actions opening while dragging a file below the notch, which could block drops onto a browser's bookmark bar; they now appear only when the cursor is on the notch.
Fixed the AirPods features never triggering the Bluetooth permission prompt on first use.
Fixed clicks in the transparent area beside the expanded shelf being blocked instead of passing through to the app underneath, most noticeable with Auto Collapse off.
Fixed the notch mini-player's album art and EQ icons clipping behind the notch on taller or scaled-resolution displays when the track title is short.
Fixed the scrolling-capture auto-scroll anchoring the cursor to a vertically mirrored position, which could misdirect the scroll for off-center or windowed captures.
Fixed the Mail Quick Action's Default option doing nothing when your default mail app isn't Apple Mail; it now opens your actual default mail client with the file attached.
Dropping files on the Mail Quick Action now opens a compose window in default mail apps that can't take attachments, instead of silently doing nothing.
Fixed horizontal scrolling through the shelf's droplet strips not working with a physical mouse's horizontal scroll wheel or tilt; those rows now scroll sideways correctly.
Fixed the Clipboard window's bottom action bar getting cut off on short external displays; the window now clamps to fit the display and stays fully on screen.
Fixed the media player lingering in the notch after you close the browser tab or window that was playing; the browser bridge now clears the session the moment the page is torn down.
Fixed Droppy's media-key handling interfering with PopClip, Enpass, and other clipboard and text tools (a blip sound and broken copy/paste); Droppy no longer watches keyboard events by default.
Fixed Meeting Controls falsely detecting a Microsoft Teams meeting (popping the HUD and grabbing your mic/music) when you were only in Teams chat or Teams was just using the microphone.
Fixed Element Capture taking a duplicate screenshot when you clicked again (or clicked the preview) while the first capture was still finishing.
Fixed a visual clipping glitch from trackpad swipes over the notch while the onboarding (or update/transcription) card is shown.
Fixed the notch rendering with square corners under the Liquid Glass theme on macOS Sequoia; it now follows the curved silhouette.
Improved Notify Me notification reliability on macOS Tahoe (it now reconnects when macOS rebuilds its notification database) and stopped it from dropping delayed iPhone-mirrored notifications.
Fixed the notch disappearing after waking your Mac from a lid-close sleep; it now returns on its own without needing to open Settings.
Fixed a crash in Terminotch when a command produced a heavy, continuous stream of output (for example downloading a model with ollama).
Fixed the Clipboard recording passwords copied from browser password-manager extensions; clips an app marks as a password or sensitive are now always skipped, regardless of the source app.
Fixed the Dynamic Island not collapsing (and the audio visualizer continuing to animate) when you pause playback from the Island itself rather than in the source app.
Fixed the physical mouse wheel not scrolling when Smooth Scrolling was enabled without Liquid Mode on macOS Tahoe; trackpad scrolling was unaffected.
Fixed Beta Updates keeping you on an older build when a newer public release was available; Droppy now offers whichever of the beta and public builds is newest.
Fixed shake-to-summon basket and shelf drag targets when using macOS Three Finger Drag.
Fixed the Basket Switcher shortcut firing on its own when set to a lone modifier key (e.g. Option); it now requires a full key combination.
Fixed a click outside the shelf occasionally closing a shelf you had just reopened within a fraction of a second.
Fixed the temporarily hidden notch still swallowing clicks and hovers in the area it normally occupies.
Fixed the file tray chip showing how many files you just added instead of the total number of files in the tray.
Fixed the file tray chip rendering on top of other compact HUDs like the terminal, recording, meeting, and AirPods chips.
Fixed unzipping a large archive freezing the entire interface until extraction finished; extraction also no longer gets killed after 30 seconds.
Fixed a failed unzip leaving a half-extracted folder next to the archive.
Fixed compressing two same-named files (or the same file twice) overwriting the earlier compressed result that was still on the shelf.
Fixed Smart Export silently dropping files when its destination folder had been deleted; it now recreates the folder or falls back to Downloads.
Fixed document conversion hanging forever on a corrupt file when LibreOffice stalls; it now fails cleanly after two minutes.
Fixed moving files to another drive aborting when a same-named file already existed in the destination.
Fixed renaming an item to an empty name creating an invisible hidden file; slashes and colons in names are now replaced like Finder does.
Fixed a resource leak in watched-folder tracking that could eventually stop folder monitoring until an app restart.
Fixed duplicate-name suffixes producing names with a trailing dot for files without an extension.
Fixed the basket window snapping to its new size while its contents animated when files were added or removed.
Fixed invisible hidden basket windows swallowing clicks and drops aimed at the Basket Switcher cards.
Fixed shake-to-summon occasionally doing nothing when the shake landed while a basket was still animating closed.
Fixed a basket re-opened during its auto-hide fade being hidden again a moment later.
Fixed a back-swipe over an extension page's screenshot gallery navigating back instead of scrolling the gallery.
Fixed previewing a HUD color twice in quick succession permanently turning on HUD replacement for users who had it off.
Fixed opening Settings silently re-enabling the Volume HUD replacement when only the Keyboard Brightness HUD was enabled.
Fixed swiping between the shelf's Droppy, Tray, and Widgets pages sometimes needing two or three attempts; quick flicks now register on the first try.

Fixed the tab swipe only working near the top of the shelf when the droplet or file strip filled the surface; swiping now also switches pages when the strip can't scroll any further in that direction.
Fixed Notify Me showing banners during a Focus or Do Not Disturb session; they now stay silent like native banners while still landing in history.
Fixed notifications arriving while the shelf was open being silently swallowed; they now queue and appear once the shelf closes.
Fixed a cleared notification being able to briefly reappear right after Clear All or a quick double dismiss.
Fixed a rare burst of replayed notifications when macOS rotated its notification database at a busy moment.
Fixed swiping a notification away occasionally dismissing the next queued notification before it was ever seen.
Fixed the Pomodoro and High Alert pills (and other small HUDs) peeking out while the shelf was still closing; they now emerge from the notch only after it has fully settled.
Extended the settled close reveal to every remaining small HUD: voice transcribe, meeting controls, terminal, notifications, AirPods, Droppy Cloud, network cards, and the AI coding chip.
Fixed clicking the notch while the voice transcribe pill was visible opening a plain shelf instead of the transcribe surface.
Added the same tap-through for the TermiNotch pill: clicking it now opens the terminal surface.
Fixed the meeting call HUD's speaker bars never moving; macOS was silently denying Droppy's system audio access because the permission prompt was missing.
Fixed the expanded media player (and lock-screen media panel) suddenly opening at the full shelf size when a legacy Regular size preference was stored; both now always use the compact layout.
Fixed the 3-day trial staying unlocked past its expiry until the next relaunch; it now ends on time while Droppy keeps running.
Fixed the lock screen media panel and status widgets staying invisible for the rest of the lock session when re-shown during their hide animation.
Fixed the unlock animation breaking (lock chip popping out without its collapse morph) when the screensaver ended while the Mac was still locked.
Fixed the lock screen media panel mounting on top of the screensaver when media changed right as the screensaver started.
Fixed waking the display while locked snapping the expanded lock screen album art back to compact instead of restoring it.
Fixed a rare crash risk when the lock screen side slider tore down while resizing.
Fixed muted autoplaying videos (news sites, social feeds) stealing the media player from Spotify or Apple Music while your music kept playing.
Fixed the previous app's album cover staying stuck next to the new track when playback switched between Spotify and Apple Music.
Fixed motion album art not loading for the first Apple Music track after switching from another source.
Fixed pausing from the notch sometimes flickering back to the playing state before the app confirmed the pause.
Fixed the media progress bar jumping backward when a song's info refreshed mid-track.
Fixed the Spotify like heart showing the previous song's liked state right after a track change.
Fixed pause clicks on a muted or background browser video starting playback in a paused music app instead.
Fixed the volume HUD no longer appearing for volume changes made outside Droppy after switching audio output, such as connecting AirPods.
Fixed brightness keys and the brightness HUD dying permanently after docking, undocking, or clamshell sessions until Droppy was relaunched.
Fixed HUDs queued behind a long-lived HUD (like the lock screen) popping up out of context minutes later.
Fixed an interrupted HUD handoff occasionally replacing a newer HUD with the older one it had just dismissed.
Fixed the No Internet card being dismissed early by a leftover VPN HUD timer.
Fixed a queued No Internet card silently blocking battery, caps lock, and other HUDs until relaunch when the connection recovered before it was shown.
Fixed the floating basket popping up on its own when holding the mouse button after an earlier file drag, such as while moving a Finder window.
Fixed unplugging a display while the shelf was open on it leaving Droppy swallowing Space, Cmd+A, and Delete in other windows and routing new drops to the missing display.
Fixed files dropped into a fresh basket from Apple Mail getting lost when basket auto-hide closed the basket during the export.
Fixed clearing the last shelf item deleting temp files that a floating basket or an in-progress copy still needed.
Fixed a slow buildup of duplicate internal state watchers across sleep/wake cycles that gradually made the notch less responsive.
Fixed Paste All pasting the last selected clip multiple times instead of each selected clip.
Fixed converting portrait iPhone photos producing sideways images; EXIF orientation is now preserved.
Fixed Clear History on Quit occasionally being undone by an in-flight save re-creating the history file.
Fixed exporting multiple selected emails from Apple Mail producing a single broken file instead of one per message.
Fixed a file deleted from a watched folder and re-downloaded with the same name never reappearing on the shelf.
Fixed converting the same LibreOffice document twice corrupting the first conversion still on the shelf.
Fixed PDF export closing a document you already had open in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or Pages and discarding unsaved changes.
Fixed closing the Compress to Target Size dialog with its close button leaving the item stuck on a compressing spinner forever.
Fixed clipboard images dragged out as PNG files containing raw TIFF data that some apps and websites rejected.
Fixed a failed target-size video compression leaving a corrupt half-written video in your folder.
Fixed the Reminders droplet's completed-task auto-cleanup never running.
Fixed removing the Reminders droplet leaving its sync timers, due-soon alerts, and quick-open shortcut running.
Fixed a Reminders sync racing a just-created task deleting it and re-adding it with its priority reset.
Fixed turning Mechey off and back on leaving it silent until the next app restart.
Fixed Mechey mouse-click sounds dying permanently after sleep or login until toggled.
Fixed Mechey soundpack installs freezing the interface and reporting failed extractions as installed.
Fixed clicking an unresponsive app freezing Droppy for several seconds with WindowSnap pointer mode enabled.
Fixed renaming a note only by letter case (test to Test) creating a duplicate instead of renaming.
Fixed pressing Esc to finish a scrolling capture throwing away everything captured instead of saving it.
Fixed the screenshot editor's undo removing the wrong annotation after moving or resizing one; moves and edits are now undoable steps.
Fixed the screenshot editor's Save to File dialog opening behind the editor window.
Fixed fast scrolling during a scrolling capture producing torn or duplicated bands in the stitched image.
Fixed the FFmpeg and Ghostscript installers hanging forever partway through the download.
Fixed cancelling a voice transcription or model download leaving it running in the background and breaking the next recording.
Fixed quickly closing and reopening the camera wedging the preview black until relaunch.
Fixed transcribing mp3 and m4a files freezing the interface during conversion.
Fixed lyrics with an embedded timing offset drifting in the wrong direction.
Improved OCR accuracy on scanned PDFs by reading pages at full resolution instead of 72 DPI.
Fixed reopening the onboarding tour permanently switching the Shelf on for users who had it disabled.
Fixed in-app links to a specific Settings page doing nothing when Settings was already open.
Fixed several Settings search results opening the wrong page, and removed search entries for settings that no longer exist.
Fixed opening Settings with the lid open silently erasing the Hide in Mission Control preference for clamshell users.
Fixed importing settings from another Mac transplanting its license and trial identity onto this one.
Fixed hiding the Droppy Cloud tab from inside it leaving the sidebar with no selected page.
Fixed the License tab showing a blank page in builds without license checks; it is now hidden.
Fixed the Clipboard window sometimes opening behind other apps' windows.
Fixed clipboard clicks being ignored or highlighting the wrong entry after a lock or unlock left phantom modifier keys pressed.
Fixed the Clipboard window's selection highlight sometimes sticking to the previous entry while the preview already showed the new one.
Fixed Cmd+A and Delete inside shelf note editors being captured by the shelf's select-all and remove shortcuts.
Fixed formatting buttons in note editors dropping keyboard focus; typing now continues right after tapping Bold or a heading.
Fixed the Thunderstorm and Clipboard shortcuts doing nothing when pressed during the window's closing animation; the reopen is now queued.
Fixed Apple Calendar event alerts re-appearing in Notify Me over and over until the event was completed or Droppy was restarted.
Fixed Cmd+A, Cmd+C/V/X, and undo shortcuts not working inside the markdown note editors.
Fixed the Notify Me widget opening at its full list height for a single notification; it now uses a compact card instead of a huge mostly-empty surface.
Fixed file conversions and compressions (video, PDF, Office, ZIP, HTML) that could hang a basket indefinitely when the underlying tool stalled, leaving it stuck with a spinner.
Fixed basket and clipboard thumbnails sometimes rendering blurry when the same item was shown at different sizes.
Fixed pinned Power Folders in one basket being dropped when toggling a pin in another basket.
Fixed creating a ZIP or folder from a right-clicked, unselected basket item leaving that item selected afterwards.
Fixed a folder preview occasionally popping up detached after its item was removed from the shelf or basket.
Fixed the Terminal droplet continuing to capture keystrokes after being disabled while its surface stayed open.
Fixed Cmd+C in the screenshot editor not working on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts.
Fixed the most recent clipboard entry occasionally not being saved when turning off clipboard history.
Fixed removing the Voice Transcribe droplet mid-download leaving a live-model download running in the background.
Fixed the notch briefly misreading Google Meet screen-sharing state for a few seconds after switching browsers.
Stopped files dropped onto the basket switcher from leaving leftover copies behind.
Stopped Quick Look of clipboard images from piling up temporary files over a session.
Stopped dropped web links from silently fetching private or local network addresses.
Fixed a running Terminal command continuing in the background after the Terminal droplet was removed; in-flight commands are now stopped on teardown.
Fixed the Widget Settings overview row only responding to taps on its far right; the whole row now expands.
Fixed the active-widget count not updating immediately after a droplet was activated.
Fixed clicking a clipboard entry sometimes selecting the wrong row or not registering after the list reordered, such as right after pinning an item.
Fixed the High Alert and Pomodoro timer ruler ignoring an external mouse; you can now click a minute to set it or drag the ruler with the cursor.
Fixed clipboard selection highlights sometimes sticking on the wrong rows in the list, pinned, and favorites sections while selecting or reordering entries.
Fixed the now-playing display lagging behind, with pause, track changes, and source switches taking seconds to register, caused by the media helper relaunching in a loop at startup.
Fixed the album art sometimes keeping the previous track's cover after skipping to the next song.
Fixed two web players open in the same browser mixing their metadata, such as one site's title appearing with another site's artist and cover.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Condensed onboarding from thirteen pages to five focused ones; deferred permissions are now requested when their feature first needs them.
Improved the smoothness of opening the expanded shelf by removing per-frame window resizing during the open animation.
Further reduced CPU usage during Microsoft Teams calls by ending the meeting-controls accessibility scan as soon as it has the call's mute, camera, and leave state.
Reduced CPU usage from Meeting Controls detection during rapid app-focus changes, such as while screen sharing in Microsoft Teams.
Slimmed the media player's hover control chips to a tighter, better-proportioned size.
Significantly lowered idle CPU usage by skipping the notch's hover edge-detection work when nothing is hovered, expanded, or near the top of the screen.

Reduced background CPU and battery drain by pausing or relaxing many timers when their feature isn't on screen, including the browser-media, basket auto-hide, clipboard, VPN, update-check, shelf-cleanup, Quickshare, and AI coding session watchers.
Stopped the meeting-call HUD width timer, low-battery pulse, and AirPods breathing animations from continuing to run after they leave the screen.
Made shelf closing noticeably smoother by holding the window's behind-the-scenes resize until the close animation has fully settled.
Made shelf opening and closing smoother in both single and split widget mode by lightening the blur the expanded surface animates through.
Made the floating basket animate back in when it reappears (auto-hide reveals and re-opens), matching its animated hide instead of snapping into place.
Smoothed merging multiple baskets into one — spawned baskets now fade out instead of vanishing instantly.
Unified the hover and drop-target animations on the basket quick-actions bar and clipboard thumbnails with the rest of the app's motion.
Made the shelf's wing buttons (Droppy/Tray switcher and Widgets pill) ride the same drop-down reveal as the shelf surface instead of fading in place.
Stopped the floating nav bar from playing a second pop-out animation on top of the shelf's own open reveal.
Smoothed shelf closing on external displays with the idle notch hidden — the fade-out now waits for the close animation to settle.
Made every element in the shelf (shadow, outline, media artwork, badges, hover controls) move on the same spring as the shelf itself during open and close.
Fixed the notification HUD fading in twice when it appears in the notch.
Fixed a song change mid open/close briefly fighting the shelf animation with its own track-title reveal.
Aligned the Caffeine and Pomodoro start/stop animations with the rest of the in-shelf motion so they no longer feel like a second shelf opening.
Made shelf open/close noticeably smoother on Dynamic Island displays by rendering the shadow on the GPU instead of re-blurring it every frame.
Made swiping the shelf closed on Dynamic Island displays fade the shadow with your gesture, matching notched MacBooks.
Removed dozens of hidden per-frame scheduling hops during the shelf open animation.
Made the shelf close slightly faster than it opens, so dismissing feels decisive instead of lingering.
Stopped a play/pause change landing mid open/close from animating against the shelf motion.
Fixed the heavy stutter when opening or closing the shelf with two widgets side by side.
Made the shelf shadow fade in and out on exactly the same clock as the shelf itself instead of finishing early.
Made the shelf reveal noticeably smoother by retiring the per-frame blur pass it animated through.
Paused the audio visualizer bars during shelf open and close so the animation keeps its full frame budget.
Made every shelf and media player animation noticeably smoother by re-enabling compiler optimization across their entire rendering code.
Made switching between widgets inside the open shelf smoother by removing the per-frame blur it animated through.
Made the expanded shelf the same width with the regular wing buttons as with the floating nav bar, instead of growing wider in wing-button mode.
Made creating a ZIP from large shelf items near-instant by linking files into the archive instead of copying them first.
Stopped the first right-click conversion menu from pausing while Droppy checks for WebP tools; the check now runs in the background at launch.
Moved Smart Export auto-saves and Save to Downloads copies off the main thread so large files no longer cause interface hitches.
Creating a folder from the notch shelf now auto-starts renaming it, matching the basket.
Unified duplicate-name handling to Finder-style " 2" suffixes across conversions, compressions, exports, and moves.
Unified the basket window's close, hide, and auto-hide animations into one consistent motion.
Made toggling basket settings reveal their extra options with a smooth animation instead of popping in.
Smoothed the expanded basket during hover and selection by moving file-size lookups off the render path.
Unified the hover animation across all Basket Switcher cards.
Made basket item thumbnails fade in quietly instead of bouncing in on the hover spring.
Unified rename, folder preview, due-date, and editor option popovers on the native macOS popover look.
Made the Clipboard window snappier with large histories by grouping pinned, favorite, and recent items once per change instead of on every redraw.
Made reopening the Clipboard window shortly after closing it instant by keeping its content warm instead of rebuilding from scratch.
Moved clipboard image thumbnail decoding off the interface thread so scrolling the history stays smooth.
Redesigned extension page screenshots as an App Store-style gallery that snaps to each screenshot as you swipe.
Restyled the to-do Edit Task popovers as native macOS popover forms with a standard text field and buttons, matching the rename popover.
Holding the keyboard backlight shortcut now keeps stepping the brightness, matching the volume and display brightness keys.
Redesigned Notify Me! notifications in the iPhone style with a sender avatar, badged app icon, and two-line message preview.
Clarified the Notify Me Hide Native Banners tip: set the alert style to None and keep Allow Notifications on so capture keeps working.
Stopped the lock screen weather and AQI widgets from polling your location and weather for the entire app session after unlocking.
Stopped the droplet preview cards in Settings from animating forever after a hover, quietly burning CPU while Settings was open.
Fixed quickly reopening the shelf during the update card's teardown window making the fresh shelf vanish in a single frame.
Fixed rapid shelf tab switches letting the shelf auto-collapse under you mid-switch.
Fixed the ZIP icon growing noticeably more than other icons on hover.
Fixed the AirPods pill rendering frozen (no breathing, instant battery ring) because its connect animation played before the pill was on screen.
Fixed hovering a scrolling filename right after un-hovering making the text teleport mid-glide.
Substantially reduced the lyrics widget's GPU load by capping its drifting blurred backdrop at 30fps instead of full display refresh rate.
Aligned the timer scrubber settle, settings checkmark, shelf glass crossfade, and outline fade with the app's central motion system for consistent feel across displays.
Fixed a second copied-text toast being dismissed almost instantly when it arrived during the previous toast's fade-out.
Fixed cancelling a basket reorder drag leaving the dragged card stuck semi-transparent until the next drop.
Fixed creating a folder or ZIP in the basket silently breaking basket auto-hide for the rest of the session.
Fixed rapid page swipes in the zoomed clipboard preview making the content teleport mid-slide.
Made opening the basket reorder panel fade the basket out smoothly instead of snapping it away.
Unified the clipboard tag editor's hover and selection motion with the rest of the app.
Replaced the clipboard background removal overlay with a quiet progress ring on the row.
Restyled the clipboard search field to match the native macOS capsule look.
Made the onboarding welcome page the same height as the other pages so the Continue button never moves while clicking through.
Evened out the expanded media player's vertical spacing; the gap below the transport controls now matches the gap above the artwork.
Made Thunderstorm's first summon instant by warming the panel and search index in the background.
Wrapped Notify Me! banners in an iOS-style translucent message card that nests concentrically inside the notch and island corners.
Restyled Thunderstorm's rename prompt as a native macOS popover anchored to the file row.
Pinned screenshot windows can now be dragged anywhere on screen instead of being clamped inside the visible area.
Made the High Alert and Pomodoro timer rulers highlight only the duration up to your selection, dimming the unselected minutes.

Reduced recurring main-thread work that could cause brief stutters, including brightness polling, the Settings permissions overview, the app-exclusion picker, and now-playing helper restarts after waking.
Fixed background CPU slowly accumulating after repeated display, wake, or unlock transitions.
Removed a per-frame allocation on the real-time audio thread that could glitch the spectrum visualizer.
Made the screenshot editor smoother when dragging while a magnifier is on the canvas.
Smoothed remaining edge cases in rapid track skips and the secondary activity pill so they no longer snap or stick.
Made the screenshot editor much smoother when a blur region is present by caching the pixelated patch instead of recomputing it on every frame.
Capped the screenshot editor's undo history so long annotation sessions no longer grow memory without bound.
Made expanding a full basket and scrolling its grid or list view much smoother with many files by removing a per-frame re-render that ran during the animation.
Gave Droppy Cloud a new icon.
Made Thunderstorm the first featured droplet in the store.
Extended Thunderstorm's Duplicate, Rename, and Open in Finder actions to any file result, not just while browsing inside a folder.
Removed the clipboard from Thunderstorm now that the dedicated Clipboard window handles it, rewrote its description, and renamed its shortcut setting to "Shortcut".
Replaced the droplet store's category filter chips with real Liquid Glass buttons.
Vertically centered the Thunderstorm Shortcut row label, the Permissions overview icons, and the Widget Settings rows so controls line up.
Moved the Multi Live Activities setting into Shelf, Layout with On and Off preview cards.
Rebuilt the Compress to Target Size dialog as a native popover anchored to the file (like the rename popover) with native controls.
Restyled the droplet Turn On and Turn Off buttons as subtle Liquid Glass instead of bold red and green pills.
Reworked the shelf lyrics to match the lock-screen look, with a tighter, narrower panel and no colored glow behind the text.
Gave the lyrics pop-out window a Dynamic Glass surface instead of the tinted album-art card.
Made long media titles in the shelf player fade out at the edge like the artist name instead of cutting off with an ellipsis.
Browser media now uses the system-provided cover art directly instead of discarding it or swapping in a fetched thumbnail.
The audio visualizer now only reacts to real captured audio and rests flat when none is captured, instead of animating on its own.
The Automix indicator also appears in the collapsed notch, and the waveform crossfades smoothly into it and back.
Muted the expanded media player's timeline slider slightly so it reads softer than pure white.

sections.title: New Features
items: Droppy Cloud share links now embed inline in Discord, Slack, Twitter, iMessage, and other apps; image and video shares show the actual file in the preview instead of a generic placeholder card.

Added hex color recognition for clipboard history; copying any hex code from outside Droppy (browser, design tool, Slack message) now shows the swatch and full color preview just like the built-in element-capture color picker.
Added a character count to the clipboard preview footer so you can see at a glance how long a copied snippet is.

Added object support to clipboard history; copying a Notion block, Figma frame, or other rich object and pasting it back from Droppy now reconstitutes the original object instead of dropping to plain text.
Added a Clear History on Quit toggle in clipboard settings; turning it on wipes the entire clipboard history and removes it from disk every time you quit Droppy.
Added a Reject Duplicates toggle in clipboard settings; re-copying text, a URL, or a color that's already in history is now skipped instead of bumping the existing entry back to the top.
Added a Falcon option to Animation Speed in shelf settings for near-instant open and close motion, sitting above Cheetah on the speed picker.

Added a Keyboard Shortcuts card to shelf settings with a recorder for opening the shelf on the cursor's screen and a 2-column grid of per-widget recorders for every installed and enabled droplet (Weather, Media, Notify Me!, Voice Transcribe, High Alert, TermiNotch, Pomodoro, Notchface, Tasks & Calendar, Thaw, Coding Companion, Mechey); the legacy Reminders quick-open and TermiNotch toggle shortcut rows moved out of those droplets' settings and auto-migrate to the new card on first launch.
Added horizontal two-finger swipe on the expanded shelf to cycle between Droppy, Tray, and Widgets without reaching for the wing pills.
