sections.title: New Features
items: This is Droppy 14, the biggest single release since Droppy first shipped: every animation in the app has been rewritten on a unified spring system, every settings page and standalone window has been repainted with the new Liquid Glass material, the Clipboard Manager and the entire shelf widget set were rebuilt from scratch, shelf navigation moved from wing tabs to a Dynamic Island style floating bar, Droppy Cloud (a built-in file-sharing service that auto-deletes after a day) ships for the first time, live voice transcription writes into the notch as you speak, the lock screen got a full visual rework with expanded album artwork plus synced lyrics plus Apple Music and Spotify motion art, and a year of speed and fluidity work makes the whole shell feel substantially faster on every Mac.

Added Droppy Cloud, a built-in file-sharing service that uploads from Quickshare, returns a private getdroppy.app/cloud/<slug> link, and auto-deletes the files after 24 hours, with per-share quotas, an AirDrop-style upload HUD with a circular progress ring, and inline previews for images, video, audio, and PDFs in the recipient's browser.

Added live Voice Transcribe, a new live transcription surface that streams into the notch as you speak with a pulsing red indicator, a transcript that grows up to 6 lines, and finalized vs interim segment styling, instead of waiting until you stop talking.

Rebuilt the Clipboard Manager from the ground up with the Liquid Glass action bar, circular glass icon buttons with state-driven fills, spring-and-bounce checkmarks, multi-select via Shift and Cmd click, content-aware drag previews with real thumbnails, custom-rename support, OCR for image entries, tags with color dots, and a 2-column layout for two pinned or favorited entries.

Rebuilt every widget that lives inside the shelf, with redesigned media, lyrics, lock-screen, calendar, tasks, basket, ToDo, weather, AI coding, terminal, voice transcription, Mechey, and Notify-me views, all on the unified spring system and Liquid Glass surfaces.

Redesigned the shelf navigation: notched displays now use a Dynamic Island style floating capsule below the island with Droppy, Tray, and Widgets segments and a sliding active highlight, and a Navigation Style picker under Settings, HUDs lets you choose between the floating bar and the classic wing tabs.

Added Apple Music animated cover art on the lock screen so songs whose albums have a Motion artwork video on Apple Music play that full-screen on the expanded lock-screen panel, with an automatic US-storefront fallback for non-US Apple Music regions.

Added Apple Music style synced lyrics on the lock screen with a centered three-line stack that scrolls in time with playback, behind a subtle native blur halo around each letter so white text reads cleanly over busy motion artwork.
Added a lyrics toggle button on the expanded lock-screen panel that swaps the album art for the centered lyrics view when the song has timed lyrics available.

Added an iOS 26 style volume slider on the lock screen that slides in from the left edge when you press a volume key, opens as a wide pill on the first tap, and shrinks to a thin pill on follow-up taps so it gets out of the way.
Added an iOS 26 style brightness slider on the lock screen with the same slide-in flow as the volume slider, triggered by the brightness keys.

Added Volume Slider and Brightness Slider toggles under Settings, Lock Screen so you can turn each iOS-style slider on or off independently, with animated SwiftUI previews inside the info-tip popover.
Added a tappable expanded album art view on the lock-screen media panel, with the cover morphing smoothly between the compact panel and a full-screen hero card and tap-anywhere to dismiss.

Added Notify Me!, a notification HUD that funnels every iMessage, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, mail, and other notification through the notch with content-aware deduplication, burst collapsing, lock-screen suppression, and a per-app history panel.
Added a No Internet HUD that drops down with a green broadcast glyph, an OK button, and a one-tap Settings shortcut whenever your Mac loses internet.
Added a VPN Connected HUD with compact and detailed appearances, an orange running timer, and a per-event auto-dismiss duration.
Added an iOS-style LIVE indicator on the media timeline for radio stations, YouTube and Twitch livestreams, and other live broadcasts.

Added a Keyboard Brightness HUD that replaces the system OSD when adjusting backlight with F5/F6, with its own toggle under Settings, HUDs, plus recordable Brighten and Dim shortcuts for Macs without dedicated F5/F6 keys.
Added a File Tray HUD that flashes a small chip in the notch with the number of files added each time you finish a drop session and the shelf collapses.
Added trackpad haptic feedback when dragging a file onto the shelf and when moving the cursor between the four quick-action targets, plus a subtle tap when the cursor enters the notch peek zone.

Added Mechey, a brand-new typing droplet that turns your typing into a mechanical-keyboard experience with built-in soundpacks where each keycap has its own tuned sound, with headphone-only routing and a shelf widget for live preview.
Added a redesigned Coding Companion (renamed from AI Coding HUD), with a compact pill that void-holds and reveals like the Dynamic Island and a new Open in App handoff to the assistant.

Added an Audio Output picker to the media HUD so you can switch the active audio device (built-in speakers, AirPods, external headphones, monitor speakers, virtual outputs) directly from the notch instead of digging through Sound preferences.
Added a Split Shelf option under Settings, Shelf, Split Shelf that turns the expanded shelf into a two-pane layout with independent leading and trailing widget slots.
Added a Widget quick-access grid: tap the grid button in the top-right of the expanded shelf to pop up a home-screen-style grid of every installed widget droplet for one-tap switching.
Added a Shelf Size picker under Settings, Shelf, with a Regular option that matches the classic footprint and an Enlarged option that makes the shelf wider and taller for more widget content.
Added an animated AirPods connection HUD with looping iOS-style pop-up animations for AirPods 2, 3, 4, Pro, Pro 3, Max, Beats Solo, and Beats Studio.
Added Apple Music shuffle and love buttons that only appear when the source supports them, plus a new Frosted material option for the lock-screen media player alongside Auto, Regular, and Liquid.
Added a redesigned basket switcher: a Cmd+Tab-style centered modal on a dimmed backdrop with horizontal cards, Dropover-style file stacks, accent-color tinting, and drop-onto-card support.
Added last-closed basket recovery so Droppy remembers the last basket you closed and lets you bring it back instantly without losing any of its contents.
Added a Diagnostics panel to the Meeting Controls extension page so you can see detection status, restart it, and copy a report for support.
Added WhatsApp to Meeting Controls so the meeting bar appears for WhatsApp voice and video calls alongside Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams.
Added a Discord moderator flow for updating the email on your license and resetting all device activations, useful after losing, selling, or wiping a Mac.

Added click-to-type and arrow-key adjustment to every settings slider so the value chip turns into an editable field and Left/Right or Up/Down nudge a step at a time, with Shift for ten-step jumps and hold-to-accelerate ramping.
Added a Subtle Outline toggle under Settings, Theming, Outline so a hairline edge around the notch and island keeps a black surface visible against dark wallpapers.

Added a Notch Width slider exposed under Settings, HUDs whenever any display uses Notch style, so notchless iMacs and external monitor users can fine-tune the virtual notch width the same way as MacBook owners.
Added an Excluded Apps list to Liquid Mouse so video editors, games, or any other app you choose can keep raw scroll input instead of the smoothed and accelerated wheel events.

Added separate Lock Sound and Unlock Sound pickers under Settings, Lock Screen, Features with all 14 macOS system sounds plus a None option, plus a Show On Screensaver toggle that hides lock-screen elements while the screensaver is showing.
Added Volume Slider Color and Brightness Slider Color rainbow hue sliders with haptic ticks under Settings, Theming, Colors, plus a one-tap reset to the original green or yellow.

Added an Open Tray After Drop toggle under Settings, Shelf, Behavior so the shelf reliably switches to the Files tab right after dropping new files, plus a Delete shortcut so pressing Delete or Backspace removes selected files.
Added a subtle file count badge next to the Tray icon in both the wing-tab and floating shelf navigation so you can see how many files are in the Tray at a glance.
Replaced the menu bar droplet with a notch-styled icon that ships with separate light- and dark-mode variants so it stays sharp against any wallpaper.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed in-app updates being permanently broken for users who installed v14.0.0-beta.7 by hardening the build pipeline so future betas can never ship without their version suffix and stranding users from auto-updates.
Fixed Notify Me! collapsing fast bursts of iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, and Signal into a single summary, so every individual chat message and email now reaches the notch.
Fixed Notify Me! silently dropping quick repeat replies like "ok", "yes", or "?" sent within seconds of each other in messaging apps.
Fixed Notify Me! truncating large notification floods to the first 10 records per fetch so a sudden burst no longer waits up to 15 seconds for the next backup poll.
Fixed Notify Me! losing original message content from history when a non-messaging app fired a burst, so the recent notifications panel keeps every individual entry.
Fixed Meeting Controls missing Microsoft Teams calls when Teams exposed its call controls outside standard Accessibility buttons or hid the control bar mid-call.

Fixed the Meeting Controls bar lingering after End Call, joining a meeting in a backgrounded app, and leaving a Teams or Zoom meeting, so it now appears and dismisses on the right beat instead of waiting up to 30 seconds.
Fixed the Meeting Controls hover bar triggering when the cursor was far below the notch.
Fixed lock-screen lyrics fetches taking up to 40 seconds when LRClib's API was slow, by racing the exact-match and fuzzy-search endpoints in parallel and capping each request to 15 seconds.
Fixed lock-screen lyrics not finding a match for songs on regional Apple Music storefronts whose tracks were not tagged with canonical metadata, by adding a US-storefront fallback before giving up.
Fixed the lock-screen X close and lyrics-toggle buttons rendering as white-on-white over bright frames of the motion video, by pinning a dark-tinted base under the Liquid Glass.
Fixed the volume / brightness slider showing the COMPACT pill instead of the EXPANDED pill on the first tap when you switched kinds, by resetting the press counter on every kind switch.
Fixed the calendar widget content jumping and scrolling out of position every time the shelf opened or closed.
Fixed the shelf close feeling laggy and delayed when a compact HUD like the media player or Coding Companion was active.
Fixed split-mode widget swaps stuttering by halving the per-frame GPU work, replacing two simultaneous Gaussian blur passes with a lighter cross-fade.

Fixed the cursed jittery brightness behavior when BetterDisplay's brightness keys, Dispatch OSD notifications, and Droppy's brightness HUD were all enabled together, by making Droppy a passive observer of BetterDisplay's OSD events.
Fixed Droppy's brightness HUD clamping the percentage label so XDR/HDR upscaling and software extra-dim values reported by BetterDisplay now show their true value.
Fixed the AirPods and Bluetooth headphone connection HUD silently failing to appear after waking or unlocking the Mac.
Fixed Termi-Notch crashing after running long commands like sleep 60 and collapsing the notch, and stopped the active command from appearing twice while it runs.
Fixed pressing play on the notch when Spotify or Apple Music was quit only launching the app, so playback now picks up where you left off automatically.
Fixed pause and play feeling laggy on rapid taps and right after closing the shelf so transport commands now reach Apple Music and Spotify without waiting behind unrelated background work.
Fixed Droppy crashing the first time you ran OCR on an area screenshot after updating, so the extracted-text window now opens reliably on the first try.
Fixed Droppy Cloud still uploading files after deactivating it, and hid the Droppy Cloud item from basket and shelf right-click menus while deactivated.
Fixed the VPN Connected HUD always reporting the first VPN configuration in System Settings, so it now shows the actual tunnel for WireGuard, Hysteria 2, IKEv2, and other modern VPN protocols.

Fixed the rendered notch silhouette being too wide on every notched MacBook (13.6 / 15.3 inch Air and 14 / 16 inch Pro) at every scaled mode, so the Droppy shell now sits flush behind the physical notch out of the box.
Fixed the physical notch shell being slightly left-biased and too narrow on regular notch sizing, so it now centers on the real camera housing.
Fixed the home and tray pill in the expanded shelf clipping behind the curved shoulder on 13.6 inch MacBook Air at More Space.
Fixed the lock-screen lock icon being replaced by the music live activity after changing volume or brightness while audio was playing.
Fixed the notch HUD drifting down into the screen on the lock screen on notched MacBooks.
Fixed the lock-screen media player and status widgets row landing on top of the user avatar and password field on tall and 4K displays.
Fixed the AI Coding compact HUD double-bopping on unlock, and reworked it to reappear with the same Dynamic Island-style void-hold and reveal the media chip uses.
Fixed the AirPods compact HUD doing the same double-bop on unlock by gating its per-branch reveal transitions to only fire on later mode toggles.
Fixed the dynamic-island close animation not shrinking to a small pill before HUDs grow back out the sides, and stopped the pill from briefly disappearing mid-close.
Fixed the No Internet HUD flashing during VPN startup so confirmed VPN connections now go straight to the VPN Connected HUD.
Fixed the Floating Basket popping up and stealing the file when you drag onto the expanded notch shelf.

Fixed Mechey pausing itself on every Droppy restart for users with Auto-Enable On Headphones turned on, the panel showing a stale Active pill, occasional silent typing while the Preview still played, and a low buzz that could loop on its own after a burst.
Fixed the audio device battery in the lock-screen widget vanishing after a couple of seconds and refusing to come back.
Fixed non-Apple Bluetooth headphones (notably the Sony WH-1000XM5) appearing stuck at 0 percent in the audio device battery HUD.
Fixed the L lyrics badge in the media widget being hidden in shelf split mode, so it is now visible and tappable to open the lyrics widget.
Fixed the Liquid Glass notch surface staying solid black on iMac and other notchless built-in displays.
Fixed pinned and starred clipboard entries appearing to clear for a beat when the same content was copied again from another app.
Fixed the Tasks quick add popover showing white text and icons on a white background when opened on an external display in light appearance.
Fixed shelf and HUD content getting clipped behind the physical notch on smaller notched MacBooks, with the Notch Width slider now previewing live as you drag.

Fixed the "On Notch Click, Media Widget" setting being ignored when the media widget was also pinned to the shelf, so clicking the notch while music is playing now reliably opens the full media widget.
Fixed Notify-me notification cards in the shelf widget clipping their app icon and text on the leading edge when a notification ran multiple lines.
Fixed the HUD notch calibration sliders skipping the 0 pt Standard stop on some display scales, so Notch Width and Notch Height can reliably return to Regular.
Fixed the expanded-shelf hit zone lingering inside dead space, so auto-collapse now fires the moment the cursor leaves what is actually on screen across every layout.
Fixed the lock-screen expanded album art clock freezing on the minute it opened until the next 30-second tick.
Fixed the Home and Tray icons in the wing-tab shelf nav doing nothing while the widget grid was open.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Retuned the shelf open and close springs to a snappier, more alive feel that matches the system's notch animations.
Improved the expanded shelf reveal so the surface drops out of the notch with a soft blur and vertical scale instead of fading in place.

Improved compact HUDs like media, Coding Companion, terminal, notification, peek, and the meeting track-title bar to shrink in place when appearing or disappearing, matching the iPhone Dynamic Island swallow feel.
Improved the floating nav bar on the notch and Dynamic Island so it pops out of the silhouette like the iPhone's cell-division Dynamic Island instead of just fading in below it.
Made hover transitions on the notch and inline interactive elements snappier and more consistent.
Made the album-art flip on track skip settle on the same curve as the shelf itself.
Made the basket expand and collapse settle on the same timing as in-shelf content swaps so they feel like siblings.
Improved the small album art on the compact lock-screen panel and the full-screen expanded artwork so they crossfade as one cohesive element on tap.
Improved the expanded lock-screen clock and corner buttons so they grow out of the top edge of the screen on appear, mirroring the way the floating nav bar drops out of the notch.
Improved lock-screen lyrics readability with a native macOS blur halo that hugs each letter outline so white text holds up over busy motion artwork.
Tightened the lock-screen X close and lyrics-toggle buttons to use heavy frosted glass with a dark base so they always read against bright frames of motion artwork.

Polished the iOS 26 style lock-screen sliders so the pill morph from expanded to compact uses one shared shape, the white fill has a straight top edge, the level bar fills with a critically-damped spring, and rapid volume to brightness switching no longer causes the icon or fill to glitch.
Tuned the lock-screen slider's slide-in and slide-out so it animates the entire panel from off-screen with iOS-matched cubic-bezier curves.

Massively cut the per-frame GPU cost of the music widget's ambient album-art glow by rasterizing its blurred composite into a Metal-backed bitmap once per track and tightening the four glow blur radii by about 40 percent.
Reduced GPU cost of split-mode shelf opens by lightening the reveal blur from radius 10 to radius 4 and removing always-on shadow rasterization buffers from each shelf widget card.
Reduced the Coding Companion's idle-thinking breathing animation from 30 frames per second to 20 frames per second, cutting per-frame body re-evaluations by a third without any visible difference.
Added wheel-mouse navigation for the File Tray and Widgets rows so scrolling up or down with a physical mouse slides the row left or right.
Refined the Widgets shelf to render as a horizontal scroll row matching the File Tray instead of a fixed 4-column vertical grid.

Improved the BetterDisplay Integration settings card with a numbered Recommended Setup list explaining how to dispatch OSD events and hide BetterDisplay's own HUD so Droppy is the single source of truth.
Refined the Clipboard Manager's inner sidepanel corner radius so it reads as a properly rounded curve while still nesting concentrically inside the outer window.
Refined the License Activated screen so the activation summary now sits on a single neutral panel instead of a doubled blue card-within-a-card.
Tightened the lock-screen notch width so it derives from the same calculation as the small media chip and stays pixel-identical to it.
Improved the lock-screen media panel so the song title and artist now sit centered when the artwork is expanded instead of pinning to the left.

Equalized the time and date sizes on the expanded lock-screen artwork and brightened the time and softened the date to match iOS lock-screen typography, with the clock moved up beneath the notch where you naturally read it.

Centered the expanded lock-screen album art vertically between the clock and the media controls, brought the audio visualizer back, and re-spread the title, timeline, and controls evenly so they no longer overflow the bottom edge.
Smoothed the unlock collapse so the lock chip closes as one continuous motion instead of starting a glide, stalling, and snapping inward at the end.
Tightened the shelf expand animation on notched MacBooks so the window silhouette tracks the content frame-for-frame instead of trailing a runloop behind.
Capped the cost of rapid shelf open/close cycles so re-entered window resizes are dropped instead of piling up async work.
Cached the built-in notched-display lookup that ran twenty-plus times per layout pass on notched MacBooks so the shelf body re-evaluates faster during the open spring.
Centered the value chip on settings sliders so short readouts like +0 pt sit in the middle of the pill instead of pinning to the trailing edge.
Made play, pause, next, and previous taps on Apple Music and Spotify near-instant by removing the 100 ms activation delay and routing lock-screen transport directly through AppleScript.
Stopped Spotify from being brought to the foreground every time you paused or skipped from Droppy.
Stabilised the lock-screen lock-icon HUD so it no longer shifts down into the screen mid-session, and kept it pinned visibly on top of the expanded album-art view.
Made Meeting Controls detection event-driven so it sleeps until a supported app launches and skips redundant Accessibility scans while you are just chatting, dropping idle CPU to near zero.
Restyled the Meeting Controls extension page Core Actions overview as a unified card list with descriptive subtitles, and added a stethoscope-marked Diagnostics section.
Routed the Update notch and Onboarding cards through the shared content-padding source of truth so they breathe on the same visual grid as every other expanded HUD.
Smoothed the drop-shadow that appears around the idle notch, Dynamic Island, and small HUDs on hover so it now eases in and out instead of popping.
Smoothed left and right swiping through the shelf widget grid so the icon row glides instead of hitching as new icons scroll into view.
Cleaned up the Notify-me shelf widget: the visible 1pt outline around each notification card is gone and the pill silhouette became a softer rounded rectangle.
Removed the redundant clear-all X button from the top of the Notify-me shelf widget; clearing notifications is done per-card now.

Made the Notify-me shelf widget use a much taller canvas in single mode (300pt vs the generic 128pt), with a hero layout for a single notification (48pt app icon, larger title and body fonts) and the delete haptic with a smooth reflow when dismissing a card.
Improved the HUD display-style calibration sliders so Island Height, Notch Width, and Notch Height use the same bounds and 1pt precision as the live renderer.
Improved TermiNotch in single-widget mode so its opened surface is exactly as tall as the Voice Transcribe widget.
Made two pinned or two favorited entries in the Clipboard Manager window lay out side by side as a 2-column grid instead of stacking, matching the Settings preview.
Refreshed the default app icon with a deeper blue glass treatment and a tighter notch silhouette.
Hardened the beta build pipeline so a beta DMG can no longer ship without its version suffix, preventing the kind of stranded-update situation that affected users on beta.7.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a license key recovery page to the website so users who migrated to a new Mac can recover their key by email without needing to contact support.

Added Color Picker mode to Element Capture: trigger it with a configurable shortcut to get an eyedropper cursor, click anywhere on screen to instantly copy the hex color code to your clipboard, with a subtle color preview shown in the bottom-right corner.

Added visual color clipboard entries for Color Picker captures, so picked colors now appear in Clipboard with a live swatch, hex code, RGB values, and source metadata in both compact and expanded views.

Added pinned screenshot overlays to Element Capture, so pinning a capture now opens the screenshot itself as a floating window you can drag around, resize, and keep on screen above other apps, with a native opacity slider underneath it.
Added WezTerm, kitty, and Alacritty as extra TermiNotch handoff options for opening the current workflow in a full terminal app.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed shelf-opening lag caused by a recursive AppKit layout pass where setFrame re-entered through SwiftUI .onChange callbacks during the same layout cycle.
Fixed a drag-out crash where dropping a file into Mail and immediately closing Droppy could tear down drag preview images too early during AppKit drag-session cleanup.
Fixed notification flood where apps like Good Task could cycle through hundreds of old reminders non-stop in the notch window after launching Droppy.
Fixed a shelf right-click race where changing selection during context-menu presentation could crash Droppy for some users.
Added per-app burst collapsing so a single app firing many notifications at once is collapsed into a single summary instead of flooding the queue.
Added a notification queue size cap to prevent unbounded queue growth from any source.
Capped the number of due-soon notifications shown at once to prevent flooding the notch after sleep/wake with many overdue items.
Fixed Liquid Glass island staying darkened on external displays after switching macOS from dark to light mode.
Fixed notch HUD text and icon being unreadable in light mode: white-on-glass in Liquid mode and mismatched foregrounds in solid mode now correctly adapt to system appearance.
Fixed the Audio Output popover closing too early, so lower-listed output devices can now be selected reliably.

Fixed a critical TermiNotch crash caused by tab-completion catalog loading blocking the main thread while sourcing the user's shell profile, which could freeze long enough for the macOS watchdog to kill the app.
Fixed a TermiNotch race condition where commands completing at the exact moment the timeout fired could be falsely reported as timed out despite succeeding.
Fixed TermiNotch's working directory becoming permanently stale when the saved directory was deleted, causing every subsequent command to fail with no recovery path. Now auto-resets to home.
Fixed a potential index-out-of-bounds crash in TermiNotch command history navigation when the history index fell out of sync with the history array.
Fixed TermiNotch's clear button being active during command execution, which caused output to briefly disappear then reappear when the background process finished.
Fixed TermiNotch tab completion not resolving quoted paths correctly, so completing inside single or double quotes now handles tilde expansion and path resolution properly.
Fixed TermiNotch tab completion not escaping filenames containing # characters, which caused unexpected shell comment behavior.
Fixed TermiNotch becoming completely unusable after running high-output commands, where thousands of lines in a single SwiftUI Text view caused render lock on every state change.
Fixed Color Picker using a custom overlay instead of the native macOS sampler, so it now uses the proper system pipette/loupe UI without the duplicate cursor behavior.

Fixed Element Capture cursor handling on macOS by moving manual Area, OCR, and Scrolling selection onto the native AppKit crosshair path, so hover-highlight capture starts cleanly and drag selection now reliably shows the proper crosshair instead of the normal pointer.
Fixed pinned screenshot overlay sizing so resizing the floating window now truly scales the screenshot itself, and added an overlay close button directly on top of the image.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Improved Area Capture drag performance by replacing CPU-based draw calls with GPU-composited CAShapeLayer rendering, eliminating full-screen redraws on every mouse move.

Tightened expanded shelf auto-collapse zones so the interaction area now tracks live content height instead of using a fixed oversized window frame, making auto-close feel precise and responsive when switching between widgets of different sizes.
Added output update throttling to TermiNotch so high-output commands no longer flood the main thread with rapid SwiftUI redraws, improving responsiveness during long-running commands.
TermiNotch's shell command catalog is now pre-warmed at launch in the background, so tab completion for command names is ready faster without any UI delay.
Refined Color Picker clipboard handling so picked colors are normalized, deduplicated by hex, and paste back out cleanly as the expected color code text.
Reworked the pinned screenshot overlay onto a cleaner AppKit window path, making the drag, resize, close, and opacity controls more stable.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Changed drag-handling internals that could cause Droppy to crash when dragging files into the Shelf or Island.
Fixed a TermiNotch shell parsing bug that could leak raw prompt or wrapper text into the UI and corrupt the current directory, and added cleanup for already-broken saved terminal sessions.
Fixed a major lag spike when selecting many files, closing and reopening the Shelf, or dropping large batches of files into the Shelf or Island.
Fixed compact Shelf quick-action drag targeting so actions only activate under the real cursor hover, without auto-highlighting Keep.

sections.title: Refinements
items: Reduced expensive selection-state work across Shelf item views to make heavy multi-select flows much smoother.
Improved post-sleep drag recovery for notch and island drag destinations so drag interactions re-register more reliably after wake.
Added several smaller bug fixes and performance improvements across Shelf, Island, and TermiNotch behavior.

sections.title: Updates
items: Smoothed the Media HUD companion transitions by removing the duplicate swap animation when opening lyrics and switching between paired widget stacks.
Smoothed the unlock handoff by keeping the same notch surface alive through the API return and removing the forced reordering pulse that caused the HUD flash.
Fixed the external-mouse 1 / 2 stack switchers disappearing on terminal stacks by removing a wrong terminal-only visibility check.

Audited and hardened Droppy's animation system by fixing shelf stack transitions, unifying basket motion, cancelling stale delayed animation loops, and replacing remaining implicit animations with explicit, consistent Droppy timing.
Removed the duplicate external display surface setting so external shelf/island surfaces now automatically follow the main Liquid Mode toggle.
Fixed the external display brightness previews in settings so the light-mode island/notch samples show dark readable icon and percentage text.
Tightened the compact white-island HUD colors so small status HUDs now use dark, readable foregrounds in light mode instead of fading into the glass.
Forced dark text and icons on the regular expanded white island media HUD so it no longer flips back to white on bright glass.
Rebuilt the compact media progress outline to follow the real notch/island shape exactly and made its show/hide behavior animate cleanly instead of drifting or popping.
Fixed the external Dynamic Island so disabling Liquid mode no longer turns the expanded surface black in light mode, while keeping the surface and text colors correct in both light and dark mode.
Removed the compact media progress outline feature entirely, including its rendering, settings option, saved preference, and leftover localization strings.
Fixed external island quick-action surfaces so their colors now adapt correctly in both light and dark mode even when Liquid mode is turned off.

Reworked browser PiP detection so non-Atlas browsers like Chrome, Safari, and Zen now keep the media HUD alive correctly, with PiP treated as an active playback state instead of being cleared by stale browser validation.
Tightened automatic light/dark appearance syncing so the Droppy settings window now follows macOS theme changes much more reliably, including automatic changing of the theme.
Fixed external display island colors so non-liquid dark mode is properly black again, and corrected the HUD display-style previews so Liquid mode uses the right white text in dark mode.
Trials will now properly start again.
Added a small close button in the screenshot preview window, to quickly close it.
Fixed the visibility of 'copied' in the small screenshot preview on the bottom right.
Some popovers didn't show dark text on a white popover view, that's been fixed.
Added full Ghostscript-based PDF compression Droplet. The latest addition to the family.
Terminotch can now install using eg. Curl correctly.
Added an option to disable quick actions, so only dropping files will remain.
Fixed a crash that could occur when SwiftUI constraint updates collided with a forced display cycle during appearance or display-style changes.

sections.title: Updates
items: Hot fix: Fixed TermiNotch in dual-widget mode so the other floating buttons stay visible, the padding matches single-widget mode, and the extra outer border is gone.
Hot fix: Moved the TermiNotch reset and open-in-terminal actions into the shared floating buttons row so they never render inside the terminal widget.
Hot fix: Reduced the lag when expanding or shrinking the shelf in dual-widget mode.
Hot fix: Restored notch-opening and stack swipe gestures when TermiNotch is present in the widget shelf.
Hot fix: Fixed the volume HUD failing to appear during active media playback and reduced the general lag around volume HUD updates.
Fixed the REC HUD so open meeting microphones no longer trigger it, while supported recorder apps like MacWhisper and Handy still show the indicator.
Fixed the Droplets extension detail view so it opens in a stable position and the extension title no longer overlaps the top toolbar.
Expanded REC detection with researched recorder and transcription apps, and tightened browser/meeting suppression so the HUD shows up more reliably for real recording tools.
Turned settings transfer into a proper two-card Import/Export block in About, with import applying the exported settings file and relaunching Droppy.
Fixed Notification HUD clear-all so cleared notifications stay gone after restarting Droppy instead of being rebuilt from old notification history.
Replaced the Element Capture, LiquidMouse, and Video Target Size droplet icons with the new bundled WebP artwork.
Added the new adaptive Droppy Stellar alternate app icon to the Theming settings.
Updated the Theming app icon picker to show all alternate icons in a single full-width row and removed the extra Style label.
Replaced the Waves alternate app icon with the updated Composer version so the existing Waves option now uses the improved artwork.
Switched the external notch/island Liquid mode to the native macOS 26 glass renderer, so external displays now show real Liquid Glass instead of the older blur-style effect.
Reworked the external notch and island Liquid mode to use the proper native macOS 26 shape-based glass path, and removed the extra stacked glass/tint behavior that was making it look fake.
Fixed hide-notch menu bar layering so it blacks the menu bar background again without turning the actual menu bar text and icons fully black.
Reworked Termi-Notch with bottom-pinned full-width input, an animated idle terminal state, multi-tab terminal sessions, and a much larger readable expanded view after the first command.
Added a live compact Termi-Notch HUD that shows real-time command progress/output in the small notch or island surface and cleanly takes priority over media while commands are running.
Added a LiquidMouse compatibility note for the current Logi Options+ / MX Master accessibility conflict, with a quick link to Accessibility settings.
Made Termi-Notch tab add/remove feel much nicer with smoother transitions, cleaner selected-tab motion, and automatic scrolling to the active tab.
Added Tab completion to Termi-Notch so you can autocomplete commands and paths directly from the input bar using the current shell command set and working directory.

Reworked the entire Termi-Notch droplet page so it now accurately explains the feature set, added real behavior settings like auto-expand, timeout, and HUD linger, and improved Tab completion so common commands and paths resolve much more naturally.
Stopped the Tasks & Calendar quick-open command from instantly closing by giving programmatic opens a short auto-collapse grace window.
Cleaned up the licensed Mac card by removing the outer grouped box, making the Mac preview larger, and moving the manage actions into the details section under Serial Number.

Cleaned up the extension settings UI by removing the redundant outer boxes from the top-level settings sections, while keeping the boxes that still matter for status, warnings, and richer management panels.
Removed the extra outer settings card around the activated license device view so only the inner details panel remains visible.
Made the small media HUD recognize browser PiP playback properly in Chrome and Safari too, by validating PiP window titles instead of relying only on matching browser tabs.
Removed the extra outer borders around the shelf widget settings previews and selectors so the widgets' own borders carry the UI without the double-framed look.
Cleaned up Droppy's resource packaging by moving bundled media and config templates out of the app source tree, removing dead assets, and stripping generated runtime junk out of git.
Kept the Extensions filters and short category results anchored to the top, so the view no longer drifts into the middle when a category has only a few items.
Fixed settings navigation so switching to a different menu always opens that page at the top instead of keeping the previous page's scroll position.
Fixed extension shop media loading so offscreen screenshots/icons now render correctly in captured store visuals.
Removed the Quit app button from Settings and cleaned up the unused localization string.
Fixed the external notch style toggle so switching from pill/island to notch updates instantly without needing to hover the menu bar or surface first.
Reduced extension-media memory usage and added debug tracing for oversized image allocations.
Made shelf widget layout changes refresh instantly, so turning the secondary shelf widget off updates the live shelf without needing to toggle the shelf/menu bar state.
removed eager clipboard image decoding, downsampled artwork and preview images, and added stack-trace logging for oversized image allocations.
Cleaned repo and bundle clutter, removed dead files and tracked generated junk, consolidated duplicate rename UI helpers and fixed stale placeholder copy.
Fixed the Upcoming menu so clicking tasks or events opens the right destination instead of always throwing you into Droppy settings.
Fixed notch quick actions so they stay visible in light mode and automatically switch to solid, readable chrome when Reduce Transparency is enabled.
Fixed circular progress rings so exact 100% now renders as a fully closed ring with no gap, including the rounded lock screen widgets and other matching progress controls.
Fixed the terminal widget close button so the visible x now properly dismisses the open terminal surface.
Fixed a crash when switching the clipboard manager between smaller and larger layouts while it was open.
Fixed the external-display notch recording HUD so voice recording now shows inside the proper notch shell instead of appearing transparent.
Fixed Droppy's quit handling so Raycast can quit Droppy directly again without making Droppy respond to Quit All Apps.
Aligned the compact media progress outline with the actual HUD shell so custom offsets no longer make the outline drift.
Fixed the Pomodoro and Voice Transcribe hold buttons so they no longer clip at the edges while being held, and changed the Voice Transcribe hold button to a subtler red.

Corrected physical notch geometry so compact HUDs and collapsed notch surfaces align with the true hardware silhouette across physical notch sizes, removing the need for manual width offsets on affected MacBooks.
Fixed Outlook attachment drops into Basket and Shelf by properly supporting Outlook's promised-file drag format.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a new LiquidMouse droplet that smooths external mouse wheel scrolling, with optional reverse scroll direction and adjustable scrolling speed. Install/enable controls are included in the Droplets panel.

Improved Shelf Widget Layout settings for external mouse users (only when detected) by switching to a left-side options list with a right-side live preview, so widget option scrolling works properly with a mouse wheel.

Element Capture now runs as a true non-activating overlay (no focus steal). The active app/window stays active, and Shelf won't auto-collapse while capture is in progress - closer to native macOS screenshot behavior.
Weather widgets now require you to explicitly enable current location (and should be more accurate). You can also set up custom locations.
Reworked the Droplets featured area into a single swipeable hero carousel with left/right chevrons, replacing the two older featured sections and matching the new split-panel style.
Removed the grouped outer container from the Droplets tab by rendering Droplets in a plain scroll view, so it no longer appears inside one big box.
Replaced droplet popup windows with inline App Store-style navigation in Settings: opening a droplet slides to an in-page detail view, and a glass back button returns to the droplets list.
Replaced premium gradient icons on the main Floating Buttons / Lock Screen rows with real in-app floating button previews (sub-option rows remain unchanged).
Refined icon centering for Files, Clipboard, and Tasks & Calendar main rows.

Made weather auto-location consent fully persistent across restarts, and added a strict privacy guard so no IP lookup request is ever sent to ipwho.is unless explicit consent is granted and Auto mode is active.

Adjusted Droplets page layout so left/right padding stays identical at all times, aligned the inline back header with content spacing, and removed scroll-triggered right-side spacing shifts in droplet detail views.
Centered the "Settings" title vertically in the settings window header.
Removed the donation + update button from the top right corner and placed them in the left menu.
Redesigned the Droplets overview rows into an App Store-style layout with right-aligned Open/Download actions, cleaner typography, and improved spacing.
Unified all segment/tile picker buttons into a native macOS-style design with compact sizing, consistent selected-ring treatment, label-below layout, and compact sub-option tiles across the app.
Refined the Settings sidebar visuals by slightly reducing icon size and removing bold weight from selected tab labels.
Made segment buttons dynamic: button widths now follow the label text (longer labels are wider, short labels more compact).
Adjusted selected segment buttons to a subtle dark/light style (dark mode: soft white glow + check; light mode: same style in black).
Then removed selection checkmarks and extra outer glow from Settings segment buttons, so selection is now shown only by the built-in highlight/border.
Removed the Power Folders toggle from Settings and made the feature always enabled, and also removed the info tooltip icons for Auto-Remove and Protect Originals.
Replaced the old pending license preview on Activate Droppy with the shared device-style license layout so activation and settings use the same updated license UI in all states.
Updated the license device preview to detect the real Mac model type and show matching hardware visuals (Air/Pro/mini/studio/desktop) instead of a generic device.
Unified the license UI so Activate Droppy now shows the exact same device-style license card as Settings, including real wallpaper preview, device info, and a partially blurred serial key.
Replaced blue license action buttons with an adaptive monochrome style: faded white with black text in dark mode, and black with white text in light mode.
Improved lock-screen media HUD sizing so Spotify and Apple Music use adaptive, wider panel widths and resize correctly when the source changes.

Added a new Theming section with named color presets for global highlight accents and subtle window/liquid-glass tinting. Theme colors now apply across primary button highlights and shared window surfaces. Theme controls moved into a dedicated Theming sidebar section under System (below HUDs), and search results jump there directly.
Aligned Reminders "Sync sources" picker buttons to the right so droplet settings controls stay consistently right-aligned.

Investigated the large-folder memory spike and hardened drop ingestion: direct file URLs are prioritized over file promises, nested duplicate paths are normalized (parent folder wins), and file-promise processing is concurrency-throttled to prevent RAM blowups on heavy drops.
Refined the 2-widget shelf layout by replacing the harsh divider with ultra-subtle boxed widget surfaces for cleaner separation.

Made browser handling universal across the media flow by replacing hardcoded browser assumptions with generic browser detection, helper-process parent resolution, and more resilient tab/control fallbacks.
Added automatic source recovery so when browser playback ends (like closing a YouTube tab), the media HUD reattaches to Apple Music/Spotify instead of going stale or disappearing.
Improved TermiNotch light-mode contrast by using a darker green accent color for prompt and pulse.
Sped up lockscreen unlock teardown so the media panel and status widgets disappear almost immediately with a faster realtime fade-out.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where Screenshot Editor shortcut keys could remain active and block typing in Settings after closing the editor.
Fixed a bug where the Pomodoro "Choose Start Mode" popup could stay stuck open after hover until you clicked elsewhere.
Improved weather widget auto-refresh reliability by ensuring background polling also starts when Weather is pinned in shelf slots, not only when floating weather is enabled.
Fixed clipboard text editing so Save reliably persists and paste always uses the latest edited snippet (no stale pastes or post-save mismatch).
Fixed lock-screen weather unit sync by decoupling weather and AQI refreshes, so lock-screen temperature no longer gets stuck with stale units and stays aligned with notch weather.

Hardened the full media source-switch flow so communication notification sounds/tabs can no longer hijack now-playing state, with stricter browser snapshot rejection, forced resync on weak handoffs, and more stable HUD visibility transitions.

Fixed shortcut routing race between TermiNotch and Reminders: terminal now opens reliably from hotkey, and Reminders quick-open switches cleanly to Tasks/Calendar instead of unexpectedly opening Settings.
Fixed Auto (Medium) video compression by adding compatible export preset/file-type fallbacks and real output-file validation, plus clearer failure feedback in the UI.
Improved Apple Music favorite reliability with resilient in-script retries (especially for URL tracks), stronger verification, and protection against state overwrite during active heart toggles.
Fixed a clipboard keyboard bug where Delete didn't work right after opening with auto-focus enabled; deleting now works immediately without reselecting an item.
Fixed Now Playing time display rounding so track duration and current position no longer appear 1-2 seconds behind.
Fixed lock-screen display targeting on multi-monitor Mac mini setups so widgets now appear on the same display as the lock-screen clock.

sections.title: New Features
items: Production-ready license checkout and fulfillment flow.
Account flow for recovering linked license keys later.
Website purchase modal and account UX aligned with current design system.
Download/update path unified on Supabase-hosted release URLs.
Release automation hardening for signed + notarized builds and cask sync.
Improved fallback handling for download resolution when API calls are blocked.
Better recovery path for users returning via account magic links.
End-to-end packaging checks before publish.

sections.title: New Features
items: Simplified Menu Bar Manager to a clear two-separator workflow (Line 1 = Hidden, Line 2 = Always Hidden) with an in-app visual placement guide.
Added screenshot destination options for Element Capture: save to clipboard, selected folder, or both, with automatic timestamped PNG saving.
Re-launching Droppy while already running now opens Settings automatically (useful when menu bar access is hidden/inaccessible).
Added optional Require Action Key To Snap for Window Snap.
Default behavior is unchanged (action keys required).
Disabling it enables no-key title-bar drag snapping.
Added optional auto-focus input for Reminders quick-open (per display).
Replaced checkbox-style droplet controls with native switch toggles for single on/off settings across droplet info panels.
Reorganized HUD settings with a new General section and moved fullscreen media visibility there.
Refined Menu Bar Manager settings lanes with full-width section buttons and clear vertical separators.
Dynamic Island notifications now use larger/two-line readable presentation with synchronized hit zones.
Dynamic Island notification width now expands dynamically based on content for better readability.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed intermittent Always Hidden visibility when opening Menu Bar Manager settings.
Removed unused collapsed shelf stack preview path and hit-zone handling, fixing notch shelf close/open ghosting.
Fixed droplet state flow so new users correctly start in Get, droplets toggle reliably, and existing setups remain preserved.
Fixed browser media-session cleanup for non-scriptable browsers (including Browser Company variants), preventing stuck media HUD after tab leave/close.
Fixed lock/unlock HUD animation for Dynamic Island sizing/margins/pill surface and external-notch/mac-mini unlock handoff top-pin behavior.
Fixed Element Capture instant-editor stale-image issue by resetting editor state for each new capture.
Fixed calendar reminder replay after unlock via stable event identity + dedup tokens.
Fixed Clipboard background-removal progress not appearing immediately after context-menu action.
Fixed external mouse switch button visibility and improved external mouse detection reliability; moved setting to Shelf placement.
Fixed Element Capture Undo/Redo defaults on QWERTZ to correctly use Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z.
Fixed notch shelf positioning on rotated external monitors by constraining notch detection to built-in hardware.
Fixed visual outlines around Floating Basket quick actions during browser-link drags.
Fixed Mission Control/Spaces interaction by suppressing notch interaction while Mission Control is active.
Fixed media HUD flicker from browser ads/video previews with transition stabilization + recent-playback handling.
Fixed media HUD pause behavior so it no longer disappears instantly after pause.
Fixed Dynamic Island media HUD visualizer occasionally shifting too far right.
Fixed shelf drag auto-collapse while moving toward quick actions.
Fixed Shelf/Basket cloud quick-action refresh so provider buttons always reflect current settings; iCloud Drive now shows correctly even if Quickshare is disabled.
Fixed regression #232 where Droppy-handled volume keys could mute confirmation sounds by switching to deterministic volume-change detection.
Improved Window Snap settings alignment: toggles now pin consistently to the far-right for clean symmetry.

sections.title: New Features
items: Added a brand-new Pomodoro droplet with a notch-first workflow, compact hover timer HUD (High Alert style), and quick focus/break presets.
Created an all-new Droplets experience with more polished browsing and discovery.

Rolled out full Liquid Glass styling across major app surfaces: Floating Bar, Floating Basket, Basket Quick Actions, Clipboard surfaces, Settings, Screenshot Editor, Updater, onboarding, and droplet windows.
Reworked Settings into a dedicated Liquid Glass window with custom title bar, custom close button, right-side Updates action, and interactive capsule controls.
Upgraded Settings search to a smarter native-style experience with keyword/synonym matching, grouped contextual results, and instant navigation.
Refined the Settings sidebar to feel closer to macOS with consistent squircle icon badges, unified sizing, and immediate tab selection feedback.
Added a new Donate action in the Settings title bar and a native Donate panel with a “Donate Now” flow.
Added alpha Beats Studio battery integration in the AirPods/Headphones HUD (not stable yet).
Expanded alpha Beats compatibility across Solo, Studio, Powerbeats, Fit, BeatsX, and urBeats with improved single-cell and left/right battery handling (not stable yet).
Added AI Remove Background directly to Clipboard image context menus, including alerts and automatic insertion of processed results into Clipboard history.
Added optional Open editor instantly for Element Capture, so screenshots can go straight into Screenshot Editor.
Added in-section drag reordering for Menu Bar Manager icon lanes (Visible/Hidden/Always Hidden/Floating Bar), with persistent Floating Bar order across launches.
Added real screenshot preview assets for Menu Bar Manager and Pomodoro in the Droplets UI and updated web droplet metadata.
Migrated Voice Transcribe to Droppy Voice Runtime (external runtime-helper IPC), removing in-app WhisperKit linkage.
Moved AI Background Removal to an on-demand external runtime via Supabase-hosted runtime artifacts, reducing bundled app weight.
Removed droplet ratings/reviews across app + website and simplified droplet stats to installs-only.
Renamed Transparency Mode to Liquid Mode across terminology and release notes.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed drag-jiggle basket behavior: with 1 basket it now opens a second basket, and with 2+ baskets it opens Basket Switcher instead of re-summoning hidden baskets.
Fixed multi-basket accent refresh issues where handles could briefly lose color after jiggle/switcher actions.
Fixed Menu Bar Manager hover auto-collapse so touching the upper menu-bar strip no longer collapses it.
Fixed Menu Bar Manager auto-collapse so moving left within the menu bar after reveal no longer closes it.
Fixed crowded menu-bar icon detection by supporting shared status windows, real window-region cropping, and improved window discovery.
Fixed Menu Bar Manager scanning/remap reliability for newly opened apps and shared status windows, removing stale ghost placeholders.
Hardened Menu Bar Manager persistence with wake/startup recovery guards so transient restarts no longer wipe saved floating/always-hidden selections.
Improved Menu Bar Manager floating bar reliability (Beta 2): wake self-heal, stronger rescans, better Always Hidden remapping, and removed dashed placeholders in favor of real icon continuity.
Fixed fullscreen Floating Bar visibility so it only stays shown when the menu bar is actually revealed.
Reworked Basket Switcher compositing to use a separate dimming window so native Liquid Glass samples real desktop/background correctly.
Fixed basket photo thumbnails that could appear horizontally compressed after reopen.
Redesigned Clipboard rendering for better Liquid Glass consistency, speed, reliability, and smoothness.
Fixed Tag Manager presentation by replacing system sheets with an in-window liquid-glass modal, removing clipped border artifacts and blocking background shortcuts while open.
Fixed Clipboard preview pane layout so image/video/file previews fill available space (instead of small centered rendering).
Fixed Clipboard preview corner-radius inconsistencies by standardizing media/document corner behavior.
Unified droplet/settings/clipboard zoom sheet hosting with native liquid-glass chrome and fixed clipped/double top-border artifacts.
Fixed expanded media visualizer initialization so paused tracks reopen with low/inactive bars instead of full-height bars.
Reworked album hover behavior to morph into a full source view and removed the older expanded-media parallax hover effect.
Fixed browser tab-close edge cases that could re-trigger mini/expanded media HUD surfaces after playback ended.
Fixed stale browser media sessions where closed tabs could still appear as playing.
Replaced media controls with native SF Symbols-style transitions: smooth play/pause morphing and directional chevron animation for next/previous.
Fixed lock/unlock HUD on notchless MacBooks by correcting lock-screen HUD window sizing when physical notch height is zero.
Unified the Lock/Unlock Animation onboarding card styling with the main HUD card style.
Unified shelf/notch/media/notification/reminders/TermiNotch motion into one consistent animation system.
Unified app-wide window open/close behavior with warm reopen and faster deferred teardown.
Reduced hidden-window memory retention window from 20s to 8s and improved transient window cleanup (capture/editor/voice/onboarding/quickshare).
Fixed clipboard open jank/pop-in by keeping the window warm, reducing list pop-in, and moving hard reclaim to delayed idle cleanup.
Fixed Clipboard memory retention by tearing down window/view trees on hide and removing eager startup thumbnail warmup.
Fixed additional memory retention hotspots by bounding metadata/image caches, improving icon cache accounting, and adding stronger reclaim hooks.
Improved app-wide memory stability by tightening observer/timer lifecycles and reducing background task churn.
Optimized audio memory pressure with safer runtime pooling.
Improved Task/Calendar opening smoothness by batching sync updates, reducing recompute/resizing churn, coalescing timeline recomputes, and removing heavy first-open animations.
Improved Droplets performance by removing full-view rebuilds, lazy-loading rows more efficiently, and reusing cached images to reduce flicker.
Improved Droplets tab scroll smoothness by reducing hover-triggered redraw churn and stabilizing stack rendering.
Fixed AI Background Removal reliability by enforcing deterministic install/validation, normalizing problematic inputs (including HEIC), and adding robust timeout/output draining safeguards.
Fixed AI background runtime install failures by switching to a live checkpoint URL and improving explicit 404 error handling.
Improved AI Background Removal progress UX in Clipboard so progress appears immediately, advances smoothly, and completes cleanly.
Improved High Alert readability in light mode with higher-contrast orange for timer/icon/status.
Unified Screenshot Editor header alignment with Settings/Clipboard while keeping close button behavior intact.
Standardized Droppy accent blue to match Clipboard selected-row highlight.
Improved onboarding HUD toggle layout so long labels (for example “Droppy Updates”) no longer clip.
Renamed Settings sidebar label from “About & Updates” to “About” for cleaner navigation.
Refined license card design with cleaner hierarchy, polished status badges, and consistent layout.
Refined Extracted Text window chrome to updater-style custom liquid header by removing native titlebar controls/toolbar strip.
Improved Voice Transcribe throughput significantly (much faster end-to-end result delivery).

sections.title: New Features
items: Added screenshot step annotations: tap, enter a number, done.
Added beautiful screenshot-editor backgrounds with gradients, shadows, and independent corner radius controls for screenshot and background exports.
Added magnifier tool support (M) with source-point placement, post-placement dragging, and consistent preview/save rendering.
Added magnifier hint badge, edge-resize behavior, and size-based zoom scaling for larger lenses.
Added a background-source option for stylized screenshot-editor backgrounds.
Added picture-in-picture mode for Element Capture screenshot editing.
Added meeting-link actions in Calendar + Task view for instant join.
Added watched-folder origin labels and tracked capsule badges for Shelf/Basket items that came from tracked folders.
Expanded Element Capture menu into a full submenu: Element, Area, Fullscreen, Window, Scrolling, OCR, and Configure.
Expanded Window Snap menus to all SnapAction.allCases, grouped with Configure action.
Added Menu Manager/Floating Bar side-aware RTL handling so Arabic/RTL menu bars behave as first-class layouts.
Added stale-notification filtering and payload deduplication to suppress repeated calendar burst notifications.
Added internal quick-view fetch path so installs/stars load correctly when opened from the eye-icon quick view.
Added quarter-step volume/brightness support on Option+Shift, including Karabiner remaps emitting those modifiers.
Added fallback to real app icon for dashed placeholders (for Alfred-like entries).
Added WebP recognition in file-converter availableConversions(for:), with JPEG/PNG-equivalent conversion options.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed screen-detection edge cases and removed the misleading mode picker on desktop Macs so external-display style controls behave correctly.
Fixed shelf/media open-close, click-drag hit handling, and alignment consistency across shelf view, controller, and drag-container paths.
Fixed Dock icon sizing in Settings to match menu-bar icon sizing.
Fixed floating-bar icon tinting by replacing contextual .primary dependence with adaptive app label colors for light/dark readability.
Fixed targeted stuck dim overlay issue after closing droplet sheets.
Fixed menu-window detection by tracking owner menus even when cursor is outside the menu window.
Fixed menu dismissal reliability with a forced close fallback (Escape + short wait) when a menu remains active at dismissal boundary.
Fixed restore-task cancellation flow by applying the same dismissal behavior before canceling in-flight restore when a restore/menu session exists.
Fixed wrong-screen menu-session persistence by hardening interactive-zone screen resolution using divider-edge anchoring.
Fixed floating bar placement/hover behavior so it stays under the divider and no longer disappears on hover or jumps under left menu-bar items.
Fixed Notification HUD foreground contrast in Liquid modes by switching to adaptive dark/light foregrounds.
Fixed white-on-white regressions in HUD/media components by removing hardcoded white text and unifying adaptive foreground logic for Liquid non-physical-notch modes.
Fixed Caffeine/High Alert foreground contrast to follow the same adaptive HUD/media foreground behavior.
Fixed terminal panel readability for command output, command text, placeholder text, and input chrome in light backgrounds.
Fixed light-mode color handling for volume/brightness HUDs.
Fixed settings icon rendering to match floating-bar renderer so white glyphs switch dark in light/white modes.
Fixed calendar layout spacing by moving calendar content up in dual and single modes.
Fixed single-pane day visibility and small-mode day-strip readability so all days remain visible.
Fixed dynamic-island + light-mode notification white-on-white issue.
Fixed Menu Bar Manager performance when opening from right-click on its menu-bar icon.
Fixed granted-permissions UI to show confirmed badges instead of toggle-looking controls.
Fixed rehide behavior to timed-only flow with delay tuning only.
Fixed Menu Bar settings clarity with cleaner hierarchy and lower text density.
Fixed default media-key target behavior to use the display under pointer for immediate third-party external display control compatibility.
Fixed stale Spotify artwork persistence when source changes (for example Eter) without usable art.
Fixed issue #267 so shelf actions are no longer interrupted by shelf dismissal.
Fixed Notify Me queue handling so notifications queued behind another HUD are retried automatically.
Fixed tracked-item lifecycle by carrying watched-folder metadata on tracked-folder drops and auto-cleaning ghost items when files are trashed externally (including closing empty baskets).
Fixed icon-menu responsiveness across Droppy icons so menus feel near-instant.
Fixed expanded Shelf/Basket thumbnail sizing to improve visual clarity.
Fixed list-row rendering overhead by caching file-size metadata asynchronously instead of per-frame disk reads.
Fixed Finder drop responsiveness by moving “drop selected to Finder” detection/copy work off the main thread and keeping UI updates on main.
Fixed drag/render overhead by removing hot-path logging and redundant animation work.
Fixed NotificationHUD cross-thread UI-state mutation risk.
Fixed ToDo list animation overhead by switching triggers to cached signatures.
Fixed screenshot-editor toolbar density by collapsing sticker tools into a single popover picker and exposing one visible color + one visible thickness control with hover/tap pickers.
Fixed symbol/accessibility consistency by including PR #261 RTL/accessibility symbol + shortcut-order improvements and missed external-link icons.

New timeline-first task/calendar UI.
New split details panel for editing tasks while viewing events.
Combined Tasks + Calendar mode, plus tasks-only and calendar-only behavior.
Native day strip navigation with week paging and improved keyboard navigation.

Select individual calendar lists.

Persisted calendar-list selections.

Optional notification chime.
Better due-date awareness for timed vs all-day items.

Week number display.
Timezone suffix display for timed items.

ToDo split view, due-soon notifications/chime, week number, timezone.
Media visualizer mode normalization and behavior.
